⏺ I get the goal — and yes, I want to plan this deeply, but four design choices change everything downstream. Before I lock in a plan, let me pin those down. Each has a default I'd pick if you say "go".  
                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  1. Faithful rewrite vs aspirational rewrite?                                                                                                                                                              
  Default: aspirational. I read "experiment to see where we should be going" as license to drop awkward shapes the current json5 carries (byte-parity hacks, legacy switch numbering, etc.) and write what
  the data should look like. If you want a 1:1 transliteration we could diff against, say so — that's a different exercise.                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  2. Truly full vs vertical slice?                                                                                                                                                                          
  Default: full breadth, lossy depth. Every system shows up (towns, dungeons, missions, items, monsters, spells, encounters, intro, NPCs, balance), and every piece of mechanical variety is represented at
  least once — but I'd let myself collapse "and 5 more like this one" into // + 4 more peasants rather than typing out every quasi-duplicate. That keeps the file under ~2000 LOC and readable in one       
  sitting. If you want literally every mission and every dungeon level enumerated, it'll be more like 4–6k LOC.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  3. Texts inline vs referenced by id?                                                                                                                                                                      
  Default: inline narration at the call site (reads like a screenplay), with a small strings { } block at the top only for things repeated across scenes (yes/no, common.*, prompts). Your "with person and
  inline text" phrasing suggests this. Tradeoff: harder to localize later, but that's a future problem and the audit point is readability.                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  4. Compilable Kotlin vs pseudo-Kotlin?                                                                                                                                                                    
  Default: pseudo-Kotlin — syntactically Kotlin-shaped, indented and braced like a real DSL, but not bound to any actual SDK types. I'll invent a tight engine vocabulary (say, ask, give, setFlag,       
  encounter, random(40..339), etc.) and use it consistently. If you want it to actually compile against a sketched SDK, that's an extra ~200 lines of type-builder shells I'd add at the top of the file.   
  
  Things I'll just decide unless you object:                                                                                                                                                                
  - State model: slug-keyed map at runtime, declared as state { flag("peasant_wife"); counter("gold"); ... } near the top.                                                                                
  - Fixed NPCs: declared inline inside their town block, with role = "rangers_quest_giver" for cross-references.                                                                                            
  - Random encounter monsters: in a global monsters { } table; one-shot story monsters inlined at the encounter site.                                                                                     
  - Maps: NOT trying to inline tile geometry; each town/dungeon gets location + a short prose layout doc-comment, and dungeons get levels = 25 with per-level encounter wiring. Tile-level maps stay a      
  "future binary asset" placeholder.                                                                                                                                                                        
  - Top-level order: metadata → balance → state → strings → items → spells → monsters → npcs(global) → world{towns, dungeons, wilderness} → scripts(reusable scenes) → missions → intro → main.             
  - Output location: /Users/marcus/src/rylween-raw/full.dsl.kts.                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                            
  Tell me which of 1–4 to flip (or "all defaults") and any objections to the decided list. Then I'll enter plan mode with the real plan and start drafting.

         1 // full.dsl.kts -- Rylween adventure, real-Kotlin DSL experiment.                                                                                                                                
         2 //                                                                                                                                                                                               
         3 // The file has two halves:                                                                                                                                                                      
         4 //                                                                                                                                                                                               
         5 //   1. DSL framework  -- @DslMarker-tagged builder types + opcode shells.                                                                                                                       
         6 //      Every body is `Unit` or `TODO()`; nothing here actually executes.                                                                                                                        
         7 //      The point is that this file *compiles* against itself, and any                                                                                                                           
         8 //      future engine could interpret the recorded structure.                                                                                                                                   
         9 //                                                                                                                                                                                               
        10 //   2. The adventure  -- one big `adventure("rylween") { ... }` block at                                                                                                                        
        11 //      the bottom assembling the full game from the world + scripts +                                                                                                                           
        12 //      texts JSON5 currently in data/.                                                                                                                                                          
        13 //                                                                                                                                                                                               
        14 // The DSL choices are deliberate:                                                                                                                                                             
        15 //                                                                                                                                                                                               
        16 //   * Slug-keyed everything. Every cross-reference (item, monster, spell,                                                                                                                     
        17 //     NPC, town, mission, scene, flag) is a string slug. No int slot tables,
        18 //     no enum-by-position. State is a slug -> value map at runtime.
        19 //
        20 //   * Inline narration (`say "..."`) is allowed at any call site for
        21 //     mission flavour. Shared / long text uses `text("speak.merchant.foo")`
        22 //     and the engine resolves the id. Scenes that the legacy game used
        23 //     `screen:` for stay as `screen("speak.merchant.offer")` -- those carry
        24 //     their own clw + waitInput so the call site stays one line.
        25 //
        26 //   * Logic ops (`on`, `loop`, `forEachMember`, `menu`, `els`) are real
        27 //     Kotlin builders, not strings. Conditions are typed `Cond`, integer
        28 //     expressions are typed `IntExpr`. Mutations are operator-overload
        29 //     property writes (`state.gold -= cost`).
        30 //
        31 //   * Random/procedural content uses generators declared once and reused.
        32 //     Dungeons declare a `randomFill { ... }` table; quest dungeons spell
        33 //     out specific floors with `floor(N) { run("scene") }` and let the
        34 //     fill cover the rest.
        35 //
        36 //   * Items, monsters and spells live in tables at the top. Special
        37 //     encounters can inline a unique monster (`monster("baron_ydarg") { ... }`
        38 //     inside the encounter scope) -- the engine treats it as an anonymous
        39 //     monster slug local to that scene.
        40 //
        41 // This file is an experiment; it is not wired into the engine. Treat it as
        42 // a target shape to grow toward.
        43 //
        44 // =============================================================================
        45
        46 @file:Suppress(
        47     "unused", "FunctionName", "PropertyName",
        48     "MemberVisibilityCanBePrivate", "UnusedReceiverParameter",
        49     "RedundantSuspendModifier", "UNUSED_PARAMETER",
        50 )
        51
        52 // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        53 // SECTION 1 -- DSL framework (real Kotlin; bodies stubbed).
        54 // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        55
        56 @DslMarker
        57 annotation class RylDsl
        58
        59 // ---- expressions / conditions ---------------------------------------------
        60
        61 sealed interface IntExpr {
        62     operator fun plus(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "+", other)
        63     operator fun plus(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "+", Lit(c))
        64     operator fun minus(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "-", other)
        65     operator fun minus(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "-", Lit(c))
        66     operator fun times(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "*", other)
        67     operator fun times(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "*", Lit(c))
        68     operator fun div(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "/", other)
        69     operator fun div(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "/", Lit(c))
        70 }
        71
        72 data class Lit(val v: Int) : IntExpr
        73 data class Bin(val l: IntExpr, val op: String, val r: IntExpr) : IntExpr
        74 data class VarI(val name: String) : IntExpr
        75 data class FieldI(val target: String, val field: String) : IntExpr
        76 data class IdxFieldI(val target: String, val idx: IntExpr, val field: String) : IntExpr
        77 data class RandRange(val lo: IntExpr, val hi: IntExpr) : IntExpr
        78 data class CallI(val fn: String, val args: List<Any>) : IntExpr
        79
        80 fun int(v: Int): IntExpr = Lit(v)
        81 fun v(name: String): IntExpr = VarI(name)
        82 fun random(range: IntRange): IntExpr = RandRange(Lit(range.first), Lit(range.last))
        83 fun random(lo: IntExpr, hi: IntExpr): IntExpr = RandRange(lo, hi)
        84 fun engineInt(fn: String, vararg args: Any): IntExpr = CallI(fn, args.toList())
        85
        86 sealed interface Cond
        87 data class CmpC(val l: IntExpr, val op: String, val r: IntExpr) : Cond
        88 data class FlagC(val slug: String, val value: String) : Cond
        89 data class ChanceC(val pct: IntExpr) : Cond
        90 data class AndC(val l: Cond, val r: Cond) : Cond
        91 data class OrC(val l: Cond, val r: Cond) : Cond
        92 data class NotC(val c: Cond) : Cond
        93 data class CallC(val fn: String, val args: List<Any>) : Cond
        94
        95 infix fun IntExpr.lt(r: IntExpr): Cond = CmpC(this, "<", r)
        96 infix fun IntExpr.lt(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "<", Lit(r))
        97 infix fun IntExpr.gt(r: IntExpr): Cond = CmpC(this, ">", r)
        98 infix fun IntExpr.gt(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, ">", Lit(r))
        99 infix fun IntExpr.eq(r: IntExpr): Cond = CmpC(this, "==", r)
       100 infix fun IntExpr.eq(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "==", Lit(r))
       101 infix fun IntExpr.ne(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "!=", Lit(r))
       102 infix fun IntExpr.gte(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, ">=", Lit(r))
       103 infix fun IntExpr.lte(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "<=", Lit(r))
       104 infix fun Cond.and(r: Cond): Cond = AndC(this, r)
       105 infix fun Cond.or(r: Cond): Cond = OrC(this, r)
       106 operator fun Cond.not(): Cond = NotC(this)
       107
       108 fun chance(pct: Int): Cond = ChanceC(Lit(pct))
       109 fun chance(pct: IntExpr): Cond = ChanceC(pct)
       110 fun engineCheck(fn: String, vararg args: Any): Cond = CallC(fn, args.toList())
       111
       112 // ---- references -----------------------------------------------------------
       113
       114 class FlagRef(val slug: String) {
       115     infix fun eq(value: String): Cond = FlagC(slug, value)
       116     infix fun set(value: String) { /* recorded by enclosing Script */ }
       117 }
       118 fun flag(slug: String): FlagRef = FlagRef(slug)

       120 class IntStateRef(val name: String) : IntExpr {
       121     operator fun minusAssign(amount: Int) = Unit
       122     operator fun minusAssign(amount: IntExpr) = Unit
       123     operator fun plusAssign(amount: Int) = Unit
       124     operator fun plusAssign(amount: IntExpr) = Unit
       125     fun set(value: IntExpr) = Unit
       126     fun set(value: Int) = Unit

       129 class MemberRef(val idx: IntExpr) {
       130     val hp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "hit_points")
       131     val maxHp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "health")
       132     val mp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "magic")
       133     val wis = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "wisdom")
       134     val cha = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "charisma")
       135     val ws = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "weapon_skill")
       136     val level = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "level")
       137     val xp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "experience")
       138     val dead = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "dead")
       139     val weapon = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "weapon")
       140     val armor = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "armor")
       141     fun isClass(slug: String): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_class", idx, slug)
       142     fun isAlive(): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_alive", idx)
       143     fun isDead(): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_dead", idx)
       144     fun isSpellcaster(): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_spellcaster", idx)
       145     fun name(): String = "<bound:pa_name($idx)>"
       146     operator fun get(field: String): IntExpr = IdxFieldI("member", idx, field)
       147     fun setField(field: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
       148     fun setField(field: String, value: Int) = Unit
       149 }

       151 @RylDsl
       152 class State {
       153     val gold = IntStateRef("gold")
       154     val food = IntStateRef("food")
       155     val torches = IntStateRef("torches")
       156     val timeLeft = IntStateRef("time_left")
       157     val hourOfDay = IntStateRef("hour_of_day")
       158     val hoursRested = IntStateRef("hours_rested")
       159     val pl = IntStateRef("pl")
       160     val cpl = IntStateRef("cpl")
       161     val cl = IntStateRef("cl")
       162     val partyMemberMax: IntExpr = engineInt("pa_party_member_max")
       163     val firstLevel: IntExpr = engineInt("pa_first_level")
       164     val aliveCount: IntExpr = engineInt("pa_alive_count")
       165     fun member(idx: IntExpr): MemberRef = MemberRef(idx)
       166     fun member(idx: Int): MemberRef = MemberRef(Lit(idx))
       167     fun inv(slot: Int): IntExpr = IdxFieldI("inventory", Lit(slot), "id")
       168     fun npcInTown(role: String): IntExpr = engineInt("npc_in_town", role)
       169     fun npcNameAtRole(role: String): String = "<bound:$role.name>"
       170     fun npcLocAtRole(role: String): String = "<bound:$role.loc>"
       171     fun pronoun(idx: IntExpr, kind: String): String = "<bound:pronoun($idx,$kind)>"
       172     fun objectName(itemIdExpr: IntExpr): String = "<bound:object($itemIdExpr)>"
       173     fun resEnum(table: String, key: IntExpr): String = "<bound:$table[$key]>"
       174     fun resEnumNameBySym(table: String, sym: String): String = "<bound:$table[$sym].name>"
       175 }
       176 val state = State()

       178 // ---- script body ----------------------------------------------------------
       179
       180 @RylDsl
       181 open class Script {
       182     // Output / I/O
       183     fun say(line: String) = Unit                           // inline narration; emits as text
       184     fun text(id: String) = Unit                            // emit by text id
       185     fun screen(id: String) = Unit                          // full screen: text + waitInput + clw
       186     fun pause(ms: Int) = Unit
       187     fun clw() = Unit
       188     fun clearMap() = Unit
       189     fun redrawMap() = Unit
       190     fun waitInput() = Unit
       191     fun statusLine() = Unit
       192     fun setBackdrop(picSlug: String) = Unit                // engine_call blitgfx
       193     fun journal(line: String) = Unit                       // appended to player journal
       194     fun narrate(actId: String) = Unit                      // emits a list of texts with pauses
       195     fun engineCall(name: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit
       196     fun emitIndexed(fmt: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
       197     fun letInt(name: String, value: IntExpr): IntExpr { return VarI(name) }
       198     fun letInt(name: String, value: Int): IntExpr = letInt(name, Lit(value))
       199     fun letBound(name: String, fn: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit
       200
       201     // Control flow
       202     fun loop(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       203     fun breakOut() = Unit
       204     fun returnFromScript() = Unit
       205
       206     // `on(cond) { ... } els { ... }`
       207     fun on(cond: Cond, then: Script.() -> Unit): ElseBranch = ElseBranch()
       208     class ElseBranch {
       209         infix fun els(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       210     }
       211
       212     // Member iteration

       214     fun forEachMember(includeDead: Boolean, block: Script.(MemberRef) -> Unit) = Unit
       215

       217     fun mutate(target: String, op: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
       218     fun setFlag(slug: String, value: String) = Unit

       227     fun playMission(slug: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit

       229     fun encounter(foe: String, mandatory: Boolean = false, tier: String? = null) = Unit
       230     fun reward(block: RewardBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
       231
       232     // Inventory
       233     fun give(item: String, count: Int = 1) = Unit
       234     fun take(item: String) = Unit

       236     fun invList() = Unit
       237     fun setInventory(slot: IntExpr, item: String) = Unit

       243         inputString(maxLen, listOf(accept), match, miss)
       244     fun inputItem(slotVar: String, itemVar: String) = Unit
       245     fun inputNumber(varName: String, max: IntExpr) = Unit
       246

       249

       575 // =============================================================================
       576 // SECTION 2 -- The full Rylween adventure.
       577 // =============================================================================
       578
       579 val rylween = adventure("rylween") {
       580
       581     meta {
       582         version = 1
       583         schema = "rylween-world-v0"
       584         textWindow = 26 to 15
       585     }
       586
       587     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       588     // Balance: every numeric tuning constant lives here.
       589     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       590     balance {
       591         upkeep {
       592             foodCostLeaderDiv = 4
       593             foodTickEvery = 5
       594             starveDamage = 2
       595             manaRegenChance = 50
       596         }
       597         rest {
       598             ambushChance = 19
       599             healthGain = 15
       600             foodCostPerMember = 4
       601             hoursAdvanced = 8
       602             hoursRestedReset = 14
       603             temperatureMax = 15
       604             tempLowLo = 6;       tempLowHi = 10
       605             tempVeryLowLo = 10
       606             tempLowDamage = 5;   tempVeryLowDamage = 5
       607         }
       608         hunt {
       609             successChance = 45
       610             timeCost = 5
       611             foodMin = 10; foodMax = 19
       612         }
       613         fatigue {
       614             level(threshold = 0,   textId = "subs.food_handler.tired")
       615             level(threshold = -4,  textId = "subs.food_handler.exhausted", drain = true)
       616             level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.food_handler.weak",      drain = true, pauseAfter = true)
       617             level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.faint",                  drain = true, lt = true)
       618         }
       619         combat {
       620             fleeChance = 95
       621             defendCap = 250
       622             hpDefenseDiv = 12
       623             encounterFoeCountMax = 8
       624             encounterPicCount = 5
       625             attack       { hitBonus = 1; damageSpreadMax = 4; confusionDiv = 3 }
       626             defend       { wsPenalty = 2; restThreshold = 5 }
       627             monsterAttack{ hitBonus = 1; damageDiv = 6; damageSpreadMax = 9; damageMin = 1 }
       628             run          { desperateChance = 31 }
       629             battleCry    { wsPenalty = 4 }
       630             dropTable("default") {
       631                 dropChance = 5; treasureChance = 59
       632                 treasureLo = 36; treasureHi = 46
       633                 magicLo = 100;   magicHi = 111
       634             }
       635         }
       636         driv {
       637             statRoll(min = 15, max = 70)
       638             start { x = 12; y = 9; gold = 1000; torches = 5; food = 100; timeLeft = 200; hoursRested = 14 }
       639             dailyTimeLeft = 175
       640         }
       641         map {
       642             rows = 40; rowsMax = 42; colsMax = 82
       643             locationBounds = (5..74) to (5..34)
       644             dungeonAvoid = "wm012"
       645         }
       646         wilderness {
       647             caveChance = 3
       648             quietChance = 91
       649             encounterSplit = 50
       650             encounterEasyTier = "weak"
       651             encounterHardTier = "wild"
       652             caveDungeonRange = 3..16
       653             caveEntryCost = 10
       654         }
       655         maxLevel = 28
       656         xpThresholds(
       657             0,       0,       2000,    4000,    8000,    12000,   20000,   28000,
       658             36000,   48000,   54000,   64000,   74000,   86000,   98000,   110000,
       659             125000,  150000,  180000,  240000,  300000,  400000,  550000,  700000,
       660             900000,  1100000, 1500000, 2000000, 2800000,
       661         )
       662         formulas {
       663             // donkey food cap = 150 + 150 * y  (where y is donkey count)
       664             formula("donkey_food_cap") { int(150) + (int(150) * v("y")) }
       665             // encounter_h1_scaled = h1_base + 2*party_avg + (first_level>2 ? first_level*2 : 0)
       666             formula("encounter_h1_scaled") {
       667                 v("h1_base") + (v("party_avg") * 2) + (v("first_level") * 2) // bonus folded; engine handles gate
       668             }
       669             formula("encounter_h2_scaled") { v("h2_base") + (v("first_level") * 3) }
       670             formula("reward_xp_per_survivor") {
       671                 (v("noc") * (v("h2") / 4) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)) + (v("sp") * 3)
       672             }
       673             formula("reward_gold_party") {
       674                 v("noc") * (v("h2") / 7) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)
       675             }
       676             formula("level_up_hp_floor") { (v("health") * 2) / 3 }
       677         }
       678     }
       679
       680     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       681     // State model. Every persistent flag/counter is declared here.
       682     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       683     stateModel {
       684         // Mission state machines (slug -> ordered states; "none" is implicit start).
       685         flag("garth.bandits",        "none", "accepted", "recovered", "closed")
       686         flag("ranger.letter",        "none", "accepted", "delivered")
       687         flag("fighter.priest_book",  "none", "priest_told", "priest_visited", "wizard_robbed", "fighter_grateful")
       688         flag("church.donation.once", "no",   "yes")
       689         flag("silver_key",           "none", "map_bought", "note_found", "thief2_squeezed",
       690                                      "smith_confessed", "cave_located", "key_taken")
       691         flag("erethor.lute",         "none", "rumour_told", "lute_taken", "note_received", "cloak_received")
       692         flag("bracelets.thun",       "none", "map_bought", "bracelets_taken")
       693         flag("nymph.seeker",         "none", "told", "wizard3t_active")
       694         flag("peasant_wife",         "none", "accepted", "rescued", "paid")
       695         flag("jazzy_ogre",           "none", "accepted", "ogres_cleared", "jazzy_defeated")
       696         flag("mastercrown",
       697              "none", "task1_assigned", "task1_done", "task2_assigned", "task2_done",
       698              "task3_assigned", "borin_met", "dagger_taken", "borin_paid",
       699              "crown_told", "crown_taken")
       700         flag("hermit.troll_tooth",   "none", "accepted", "extracted", "delivered", "fire_shield_acquired")
       701         flag("encounter.immune",     "no", "yes", scope = "encounter")
       702
       703         counter("gold",        initial = 1000)
       704         counter("food",        initial = 100)
       705         counter("torches",     initial = 5)
       706         counter("time_left",   initial = 200)
       707         counter("hour_of_day", initial = 5)
       708         counter("hours_rested",initial = 14)
       709         counter("pl",          initial = 4)
       710     }
       711
       712     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       713     // Enums. Slug-keyed; `id` from the legacy json5 is dropped -- callers refer
       714     // to entries by slug only.
       715     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       716     enums {
       717         enum("race") {
       718             entry("human")
       719             entry("dwarf")
       720             entry("elf")
       721             entry("halfling")
       722         }
       723         enum("pc_class") {
       724             entry("fighter") {
       725                 name = "Fighter"
       726                 minStat("weapon_skill", 50, "driv.create.weapon_skill_low")
       727                 levelup { weaponSkill = 3; health = 8; wisdom = 1; charisma = 1 }
       728             }
       729             entry("thief") {
       730                 name = "Thief"
       731                 levelup { weaponSkill = 1; health = 5; wisdom = 1; charisma = 2 }
       732             }
       733             entry("mage") {
       734                 name = "Mage"
       735                 minStat("wisdom", 50, "driv.create.wisdom_low")
       736                 spells("mage.frost", "mage.fire", "mage.confusion",
       737                        "mage.death", "mage.hold", "mage.antimagic")
       738                 castsIn("combat")

       872         // Magic items each carry a self-contained effect script. The bodies
       873         // here are lossy summaries -- the original DSL had 5..30 ops per item;
       874         // I record the *shape* of what each does.
       875         magic {
       876             magic("frost_wand", "Frost Wand", 1000) {
       877                 // wand shoots a cold beam at one foe, computing damage like
       878                 // mage.frost; consumed after use.
       879                 say("The wand crackles with frost.")
       880                 cast("mage.frost")
       881                 take("frost_wand")
       882             }
       883             magic("fire_wand", "Fire Wand", 1500) {
       884                 say("Flames erupt from the wand.")
       885                 cast("mage.fire")
       886                 take("fire_wand")
       887             }
       888             magic("gem_of_confusion", "Gem of Confusion", 800) {
       889                 say("The gem flares. Foes look bewildered.")
       890                 cast("mage.confusion")
       891                 take("gem_of_confusion")
       892             }
       893             magic("gem_of_blindness", "Gem of Blindness", 800) {
       894                 say("Light explodes from the gem.")
       895                 cast("mage.confusion")  // blindness routes through confusion path
       896                 take("gem_of_blindness")
       897             }
       898             magic("drums_of_death", "Drums of Death", 9000) {
       899                 say("A funereal drumbeat pounds. The earth trembles.")
       900                 cast("priest.earthquake")
       901                 take("drums_of_death")
       902             }
       903             magic("staff_of_healing", "Staff of Healing", 670) {
       904                 menu("Heal whom?") {
       905                     digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
       906                         on(state.member(who).isAlive()) {
       907                             state.member(who).setField("hit_points",
       908                                 state.member(who)["health"])
       909                             say("The staff bathes ${state.member(who).name()} in gold light.")
       910                             pause(800)
       911                         } els {
       912                             say("They are beyond a healing.")
       913                             pause(800)
       914                         }
       915                     }
       916                 }
       917             }
       918             magic("blessing_scroll", "Blessing Scroll", 250) {
       919                 say("You read the blessing aloud. Hearts strengthen.")
       920                 forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
       921                 take("blessing_scroll")
       922             }
       923             magic("staff_of_curing", "Staff of Curing", 480) {
       924                 forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
       925                 say("A wave of warmth fills the party.")
       926             }
       927             magic("gem_of_resurrection", "Gem of Resurrection", 12000) {
       928                 menu("Whom to revive?") {
       929                     digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
       930                         on(state.member(who).isDead()) {
       931                             state.member(who).setField("dead", 0)
       932                             state.member(who).setField("hit_points", 1)
       933                             state.pl += 1
       934                             say("Life flows back into ${state.member(who).name()}.")
       935                             pause(1200)
       936                         } els {
       937                             say("They live still.")
       938                         }
       939                     }
       940                 }
       941                 take("gem_of_resurrection")
       942             }
       943             magic("kaels_axe", "Kael's Axe", 6000) {
       944                 // Throw-and-return: hits all foes for moderate damage.

       946                 // Effect handled via tagged combat hook.

       948             }

      1072     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1073     // Spells. Each effect is a self-contained Script body. The legacy DSL had
      1074     // 30..70 ops per spell; the bodies below capture the *shape* and key
      1075     // mechanics, with verbatim mana / target / damage rules where possible.
      1076     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1077     spells {
      1078         mage("frost", slot = 1, baseCost = 8, name = "Frost Finger") {
      1079             // Single-target cold beam. Damage = caster.level * (random 1..wis/3).
      1080             engineCall("ask_target")  // -> binds `target`
      1081             val dmg = letInt("dmg", state.member(v("caster")).level *
      1082                                     random(int(1), state.member(v("caster")).wis / 3))
      1083             text("spell.frost.beam")
      1084             pause(800)
      1085             mutate("monster.hp", "sub", v("dmg"))
      1086             on(engineCheck("monster_dead", v("target"))) {
      1087                 text("spell.kill")
      1088             }
      1089         }
      1090         mage("fire", slot = 2, baseCost = 25, name = "Fire Cloud") {
      1091             // AoE: rolls per-monster damage.
      1092             text("spell.fire.cloud")
      1093             pause(1000)
      1094             engineCall("for_each_monster",
      1095                 "body" to "spell.fire.tick")
      1096         }
      1097         mage("confusion", slot = 3, baseCost = 17, name = "Confusion") {
      1098             text("spell.confusion.sweeps")
      1099             pause(800)
      1100             engineCall("set_battle_flag", "confusion")
      1101         }
      1102         mage("death", slot = 4, baseCost = 78, name = "Death") {
      1103             engineCall("ask_target")
      1104             text("spell.death.invoke")
      1105             pause(1500)
      1106             on(chance(60)) {
      1107                 engineCall("monster_kill", v("target"))
      1108                 text("spell.kill")
      1109             } els {

      1480     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1481     // Reusable scenes. Town services first, then dungeon encounters, then
      1482     // dialog dispatchers. Bindings the C wrappers used (open_lo, who, ...)
      1483     // come in via runScene().
      1484     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1485     scenes {
      1486         // -------- Town: hut greeter (T)alk / (L)eave -------------------------
      1487         scene("hut", expects = arrayOf("who", "npc_job_sym")) {
      1488             loop {
      1489                 clw()
      1490                 letBound("job",  "res_enum_name_by_sym", "job", v("npc_job_sym"))
      1491                 letBound("name", "res_enum",            "name", v("who"))
      1492                 screen("towne.hut.greeter")
      1493                 menu("menu") {
      1494                     option("T") { runScene("speak.dispatch", "building" to "none", "town" to 0) }
      1495                     option("L") { clw(); clearMap(); redrawMap(); breakOut() }
      1496                 }
      1497             }
      1498         }
      1499
      1500         // -------- Town: rumour roll. 33 rumours with four NPC-tagged cases. --
      1501         scene("rumour") {
      1502             val pick = letInt("pick", engineInt("rumour_roll"))
      1503             on(pick eq 12) {
      1504                 letBound("name1", "npc_name_at_role", "bandits_quest_giver"); text("towne.rumour.r12")
      1505             } els {
      1506                 on(pick eq 13) {
      1507                     letBound("name2", "npc_name_at_role", "rangers_quest_giver"); text("towne.rumour.r13")
      1508                 } els {
      1509                     on(pick eq 25) {
      1510                         letBound("name15", "npc_name_at_role", "crown_seer")
      1511                         letBound("loc15",  "npc_loc_at_role",  "crown_seer")
      1512                         text("towne.rumour.r25")
      1513                     } els {
      1514                         on(pick eq 27) {
      1515                             letBound("name13", "npc_name_at_role", "temple_of_thun_seer")
      1516                             letBound("loc13",  "npc_loc_at_role",  "temple_of_thun_seer")
      1517                             text("towne.rumour.r27")
      1518                         } els {
      1519                             emitIndexed("towne.rumour.r{}", v("pick"))
      1520                         }
      1521                     }
      1522                 }
      1523             }
      1524         }
      1525
      1526         // -------- Town: church (Heal/Raise/Energize/Leave) -------------------
      1527         scene("church") {
      1528             clearMap()
      1529             setBackdrop("church")
      1530             loop {
      1531                 clw(); statusLine()
      1532                 screen("towne.church.intro")
      1533                 menu("menu") {
      1534                     option("L") { clw(); clearMap(); breakOut() }
      1535                     option("E") { runScene("church.energize") }
      1536                     option("R") { runScene("church.raise") }
      1537                     option("H") { runScene("church.heal") }
      1538                 }
      1539             }
      1540         }
      1541         scene("church.energize") {
      1542             clw(); screen("towne.church.who")
      1543             menu {
      1544                 digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
      1545                     on(!state.member(who).isSpellcaster()) {
      1546                         clw(); screen("towne.church.not_spellcaster"); pause(1000)
      1547                     } els {
      1548                         on(state.member(who).mp eq state.member(who).wis) {
      1549                             clw(); screen("towne.church.no_need_sp"); pause(2000)
      1550                         } els {
      1551                             // cost = lv * (wi - ma) * 2
      1552                             val cost = letInt("cost",
      1553                                 state.member(who).level * (state.member(who).wis - state.member(who).mp) * 2)
      1554                             screen("towne.church.cost2")
      1555                             menu("pn_menu") {
      1556                                 option("P") {
      1557                                     clw()
      1558                                     on(state.gold lt v("cost")) {
      1559                                         screen("towne.church.no_gold"); pause(1000)
      1560                                     } els {
      1561                                         state.gold -= v("cost")
      1562                                         state.member(who).setField("magic", state.member(who).wis)
      1563                                         clw(); screen("towne.church.restored"); pause(1000)
      1564                                     }
      1565                                 }
      1566                             }
      1567                         }
      1568                     }
      1569                 }
      1570             }

      2084                                     letBound("who_name", "pa_name", who)
      2085                                     screen("hunt.tries"); pause(800)
      2086                                     on(chance(45)) {
      2087                                         val gain = letInt("fdplus",
      2088                                             random(int(10), int(19)) + state.member(who).level)
      2089                                         state.food += v("fdplus")
      2090                                         screen("hunt.succeeds")
      2091                                     } els {
      2092                                         screen("hunt.fails")
      2093                                     }
      2094                                     waitInput(); clw(); breakOut()
      2095                                 }
      2096                             }
      2097                         }
      2098                     }
      2099                 }
      2100             }
      2101         }

      2157                     clw(); emitIndexed("subs.equipment.invalid_{}", v("kind"))
      2158                     pause(1000); clw()

      2161                     menu {
      2162                         digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->

      2164                                 val temp = letInt("temp", state.member(who)[v("kind").toString()])
      2165                                 state.member(who).setField(v("kind").toString(), v("oc"))
      2166                                 engineCall("pa_set_inventory", v("slot"), v("temp"))
      2167                                 clw(); emitIndexed("subs.equipment.changed_{}", v("kind")); pause(1000); clw()
      2168                             }

      2176         // -------- Rest --------------------------------------------------------
      2177         scene("rest") {
      2178             // Early gates.
      2179             on(state.hoursRested gt 0) {
      2180                 clw(); screen("rest.not_tired"); returnFromScript()
      2181             }
      2182             on(state.aliveCount eq 0) { returnFromScript() }
      2183             on(engineCheck("inv_has", "tent")) { setBackdrop("tent") } els { setBackdrop("notent") }
      2184
      2185             // Pick a guard (or no guard).
      2186             screen("rest.camp_intro")
      2187             val guard = letInt("guard", -1)
      2188             menu {
      2189                 option("Y") {
      2190                     loop {
      2191                         clw(); screen("rest.who")
      2192                         menu {
      2193                             digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
      2194                                 on(state.member(who).isDead()) {
      2195                                     clw(); screen("rest.dead"); pause(1000)
      2196                                 } els {
      2197                                     mutate("guard", "set", who); breakOut()
      2198                                 }
      2199                             }
      2200                             default { clw(); screen("rest.not_valid"); pause(1000) }
      2201                         }
      2202                     }
      2203                 }
      2204                 option("N") { /* no guard */ }
      2205             }
      2206             on(v("guard") gte 1) { screen("rest.stands_guard") }
      2207             screen("rest.zzz"); pause(2000)
      2208
      2209             // Temperature roll.
      2210             val temp = letInt("temp", random(int(1), int(15)))
      2211             on((v("temp") gte 6) and (v("temp") lte 10)) {
      2212                 on(!engineCheck("inv_has", "blanket") and !engineCheck("inv_has", "tent")) {
      2213                     screen("rest.temp_low"); screen("rest.no_gear_5")
      2214                     forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m.hp - 5); engineCall("clamp_hp", m.idx) }
      2215                 }
      2216             }
      2217             on(v("temp") gt 10) {
      2218                 on(!engineCheck("inv_has", "tent")) {
      2219                     screen("rest.temp_very_low"); screen("rest.no_gear_10")
      2220                     forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m.hp - 5); engineCall("clamp_hp", m.idx) }
      2221                 }
      2222             }
      2223
      2224             // Hours pass.
      2225             engineCall("advance_hour", "amount" to int(8))
      2226             state.hoursRested.set(14)
      2227             mutate("food", "sub", v("food_per_member") * state.pl)
      2228             engineCall("clamp_food_min", 0)
      2229
      2230             // Healing per non-guard non-dead member.
      2231             forEachMember { m ->
      2232                 on(m.idx ne v("guard") and !m.isDead()) {
      2233                     m.setField("hit_points", m.hp + 15); engineCall("clamp_hp", m.idx)
      2234                 }
      2235             }
      2236
      2237             // Ambush vs well-rested.
      2238             on(chance(19)) {
      2239                 screen("rest.ambush")
      2240                 on(v("guard") eq -1) {
      2241                     val victim = letInt("victim", random(int(1), state.partyMemberMax))
      2242                     letBound("victim_name", "pa_name", v("victim"))
      2243                     screen("rest.surprise_kill")
      2244                     state.member(v("victim")).setField("hit_points", 0)
      2245                     state.member(v("victim")).setField("dead", 1)
      2246                     state.pl -= 1
      2247                 }
      2248                 encounter("kobold", tier = "weak")
      2249             } els {
      2250                 screen("rest.well_rested"); clearMap()
      2251             }
      2252             redrawMap()
      2253         }

⏺ Tier E1/E2 audit — findings

  Audited all 11 shards in data/world/scripts/ (4260 LOC). Concrete picks below; no commits yet.

  E1 — collapse candidates (ranked)

  1. Encounter post-redraw tail — clr_map_window + blitgfx insidecave + clw repeats 17× in dungeon.json5 (~102 LOC). Trivial to lift to a one-line op. Highest ROI, lowest risk.

  2. "Who?" member-picker w/ dead-check + re-prompt — repeats 6× across hunt/rest/subs/towne (~180 LOC of boilerplate). Shape: emit 'who' → digit_range over pa_party_member_max → pa_is_dead guard →
  fallback re-prompt. Best as a new DSL op (e.g. member_pick) since the bodies it wraps are heterogeneous.

  3. Cost-check + pay-or-no_gold — 5× in towne.json5 (~70 LOC). Shape: let cost → emit cost* → P-key menu → lt gold cost → no_gold / sub-gold + service. Could be service_with_cost { cost, on_pay: [...] }.
   Medium difficulty — the else: payloads vary, so the helper has to thread a body through.

  Anti-candidates (don't lift): thun_riddle1/2/3 (per-riddle answers + foes + trailing-redraw differences are intentional byte-parity); per-service mutation payloads in church/smith/lodge (looks similar,
  but the mutation targets differ enough that parameterizing loses readability); emit/pause/clw strings (stylistic, not structural).

  E2 — RNG / magic-number lifts

  Worth lifting to a balance table:
  - dungeon.json5:105 — gold pile random[40,339]
  - dungeon.json5:115 — torches random[2,4]
  - dungeon.json5:167 — hobgoblin password drop chance: 39
  - towne.json5:386 — smith beer-offer chance: 9

  Marginal (table-index ranges, not balance):
  - find_object tier ranges (dungeon.json5:318–336) — these encode item-table layout; better as a comment/table than a knob.

  Already parameterized (fine as-is): gold_chest trap_chance branching, hunt food_min/max bindings, rest temp_max binding, smith haggle 0..99 + 76/90 thresholds (the thresholds are the real knobs, not the
   roll).

  Bonus

  - towne.json5 size — 1663 LOC, dominated by the church E/R/H cascade. A future shard split (church.json5 / smith.json5 / etc.) would compose with picks #2 and #3 above.
  - dungeon.json5 ordering — symbolic keys decoupled the cases from the original switch numbering; worth a one-time check that world.json5::enums.dungeon_encounter still matches the comments.

  Recommendation

  Most session-sized + cleanest payoff: #1 (encounter tail) alone. Roughly a one-op DSL addition + a pure mechanical sweep across dungeon.json5; ~100 LOC drop, byte-parity easy to verify against existing
  fixtures. #4 in E2 (the four balance knobs) can ride along in the same session if you want a combined plan-bookkeeping commit.

  #2 (member-picker) is the highest-impact lift but requires a real DSL design call (new op vs. sub-script vs. macro) — worth doing, but probably wants its own session.

  Want me to scope #1 (and optionally the four balance knobs) as a concrete plan, or pick a different one?

⏺ I get the goal — and yes, I want to plan this deeply, but four design choices change everything downstream. Before I lock in a plan, let me pin those down. Each has a default I'd pick if you say "go".

  1. Faithful rewrite vs aspirational rewrite?
  Default: aspirational. I read "experiment to see where we should be going" as license to drop awkward shapes the current json5 carries (byte-parity hacks, legacy switch numbering, etc.) and write what
  the data should look like. If you want a 1:1 transliteration we could diff against, say so — that's a different exercise.

  2. Truly full vs vertical slice?
  Default: full breadth, lossy depth. Every system shows up (towns, dungeons, missions, items, monsters, spells, encounters, intro, NPCs, balance), and every piece of mechanical variety is represented at
  least once — but I'd let myself collapse "and 5 more like this one" into // + 4 more peasants rather than typing out every quasi-duplicate. That keeps the file under ~2000 LOC and readable in one
  sitting. If you want literally every mission and every dungeon level enumerated, it'll be more like 4–6k LOC.

  3. Texts inline vs referenced by id?
  Default: inline narration at the call site (reads like a screenplay), with a small strings { } block at the top only for things repeated across scenes (yes/no, common.*, prompts). Your "with person and
  inline text" phrasing suggests this. Tradeoff: harder to localize later, but that's a future problem and the audit point is readability.

  4. Compilable Kotlin vs pseudo-Kotlin?
  Default: pseudo-Kotlin — syntactically Kotlin-shaped, indented and braced like a real DSL, but not bound to any actual SDK types. I'll invent a tight engine vocabulary (say, ask, give, setFlag,
  encounter, random(40..339), etc.) and use it consistently. If you want it to actually compile against a sketched SDK, that's an extra ~200 lines of type-builder shells I'd add at the top of the file.

  Things I'll just decide unless you object:
  - State model: slug-keyed map at runtime, declared as state { flag("peasant_wife"); counter("gold"); ... } near the top.
  - Fixed NPCs: declared inline inside their town block, with role = "rangers_quest_giver" for cross-references.
  - Random encounter monsters: in a global monsters { } table; one-shot story monsters inlined at the encounter site.
  - Maps: NOT trying to inline tile geometry; each town/dungeon gets location + a short prose layout doc-comment, and dungeons get levels = 25 with per-level encounter wiring. Tile-level maps stay a
  "future binary asset" placeholder.
  - Top-level order: metadata → balance → state → strings → items → spells → monsters → npcs(global) → world{towns, dungeons, wilderness} → scripts(reusable scenes) → missions → intro → main.
  - Output location: /Users/marcus/src/rylween-raw/full.dsl.kts.

  Tell me which of 1–4 to flip (or "all defaults") and any objections to the decided list. Then I'll enter plan mode with the real plan and start drafting.

         1 // full.dsl.kts -- Rylween adventure, real-Kotlin DSL experiment.
         2 //
         3 // The file has two halves:
         4 //
         5 //   1. DSL framework  -- @DslMarker-tagged builder types + opcode shells.
         6 //      Every body is `Unit` or `TODO()`; nothing here actually executes.
         7 //      The point is that this file *compiles* against itself, and any
         8 //      future engine could interpret the recorded structure.
         9 //
        10 //   2. The adventure  -- one big `adventure("rylween") { ... }` block at
        11 //      the bottom assembling the full game from the world + scripts +
        12 //      texts JSON5 currently in data/.
        13 //
        14 // The DSL choices are deliberate:
        15 //
        16 //   * Slug-keyed everything. Every cross-reference (item, monster, spell,
        17 //     NPC, town, mission, scene, flag) is a string slug. No int slot tables,
        18 //     no enum-by-position. State is a slug -> value map at runtime.
        19 //
        20 //   * Inline narration (`say "..."`) is allowed at any call site for
        21 //     mission flavour. Shared / long text uses `text("speak.merchant.foo")`
        22 //     and the engine resolves the id. Scenes that the legacy game used
        23 //     `screen:` for stay as `screen("speak.merchant.offer")` -- those carry
        24 //     their own clw + waitInput so the call site stays one line.
        25 //
        26 //   * Logic ops (`on`, `loop`, `forEachMember`, `menu`, `els`) are real
        27 //     Kotlin builders, not strings. Conditions are typed `Cond`, integer
        28 //     expressions are typed `IntExpr`. Mutations are operator-overload
        29 //     property writes (`state.gold -= cost`).
        30 //
        31 //   * Random/procedural content uses generators declared once and reused.
        32 //     Dungeons declare a `randomFill { ... }` table; quest dungeons spell
        33 //     out specific floors with `floor(N) { run("scene") }` and let the
        34 //     fill cover the rest.
        35 //
        36 //   * Items, monsters and spells live in tables at the top. Special
        37 //     encounters can inline a unique monster (`monster("baron_ydarg") { ... }`
        38 //     inside the encounter scope) -- the engine treats it as an anonymous
        39 //     monster slug local to that scene.
        40 //
        41 // This file is an experiment; it is not wired into the engine. Treat it as
        42 // a target shape to grow toward.
        43 //
        44 // =============================================================================
        45
        46 @file:Suppress(
        47     "unused", "FunctionName", "PropertyName",
        48     "MemberVisibilityCanBePrivate", "UnusedReceiverParameter",
        49     "RedundantSuspendModifier", "UNUSED_PARAMETER",
        50 )

       180 @RylDsl
       181 open class Script {
       182     // Output / I/O
       183     fun say(line: String) = Unit                           // inline narration; emits as text
       184     fun text(id: String) = Unit                            // emit by text id
       185     fun screen(id: String) = Unit                          // full screen: text + waitInput + clw
       186     fun pause(ms: Int) = Unit
       187     fun clw() = Unit
       188     fun clearMap() = Unit
       189     fun redrawMap() = Unit
       190     fun waitInput() = Unit
       191     fun statusLine() = Unit
       192     fun setBackdrop(picSlug: String) = Unit                // engine_call blitgfx
       193     fun journal(line: String) = Unit                       // appended to player journal
       194     fun narrate(actId: String) = Unit                      // emits a list of texts with pauses
       195     fun engineCall(name: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit
       196     fun emitIndexed(fmt: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
       197     fun letInt(name: String, value: IntExpr): IntExpr { return VarI(name) }
       198     fun letInt(name: String, value: Int): IntExpr = letInt(name, Lit(value))
       199     fun letBound(name: String, fn: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit
       200
       201     // Control flow
       202     fun loop(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       203     fun breakOut() = Unit
       204     fun returnFromScript() = Unit
       205
       206     // `on(cond) { ... } els { ... }`
       207     fun on(cond: Cond, then: Script.() -> Unit): ElseBranch = ElseBranch()
       208     class ElseBranch {
       209         infix fun els(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       210     }
       211
       212     // Member iteration
       213     fun forEachMember(block: Script.(MemberRef) -> Unit) = Unit
       214     fun forEachMember(includeDead: Boolean, block: Script.(MemberRef) -> Unit) = Unit
       215
       216     // Mutation primitives that don't fit operator overloads
       217     fun mutate(target: String, op: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
       218     fun setFlag(slug: String, value: String) = Unit
       219     fun setFlag(ref: FlagRef, value: String) = Unit
       220     fun flagValue(slug: String): IntExpr = engineInt("flag_value", slug)
       221
       222     // Menus
       223     fun menu(prompt: String? = null, block: MenuBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
       224
       225     // World / scene calls
       226     fun runScene(slug: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
       227     fun playMission(slug: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
       228     fun enterDungeon(slug: String) = Unit
       229     fun encounter(foe: String, mandatory: Boolean = false, tier: String? = null) = Unit
       230     fun reward(block: RewardBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
       231
       232     // Inventory
       233     fun give(item: String, count: Int = 1) = Unit
       234     fun take(item: String) = Unit
       235     fun invAdd(itemId: IntExpr, added: Script.() -> Unit, full: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       236     fun invList() = Unit
       237     fun setInventory(slot: IntExpr, item: String) = Unit
       238     fun setInventory(slot: Int, item: String) = Unit
       239
       240     // Input
       241     fun inputString(maxLen: Int, accept: List<String>, match: Script.() -> Unit, miss: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       242     fun inputString(maxLen: Int, accept: String, match: Script.() -> Unit, miss: Script.() -> Unit) =
       243         inputString(maxLen, listOf(accept), match, miss)
       244     fun inputItem(slotVar: String, itemVar: String) = Unit
       245     fun inputNumber(varName: String, max: IntExpr) = Unit
       246
       247     // Casting + spell support
       248     fun cast(spell: String) = Unit
       249
       250     // Utility for inline expressions referring to a previously-bound `let`.
       251     operator fun String.unaryPlus(): IntExpr = VarI(this)
       252 }
       253
       254 @RylDsl

       257     fun digitRange(lo: Int, hi: IntExpr, indexVar: String = "who", then: Script.(IntExpr) -> Unit) = Unit
       258     fun keyRange(lo: String, hi: String, then: Script.(IntExpr) -> Unit) = Unit
       259     fun letterRange(lo: String, hi: String, then: Script.(IntExpr) -> Unit) = Unit
       260     fun default(then: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       261 }

       270 }

       575 // =============================================================================
       576 // SECTION 2 -- The full Rylween adventure.
       577 // =============================================================================
       578
       579 val rylween = adventure("rylween") {
       580
       581     meta {
       582         version = 1
       583         schema = "rylween-world-v0"
       584         textWindow = 26 to 15
       585     }
       586
       587     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       588     // Balance: every numeric tuning constant lives here.
       589     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       590     balance {
       591         upkeep {
       592             foodCostLeaderDiv = 4
       593             foodTickEvery = 5
       594             starveDamage = 2
       595             manaRegenChance = 50
       596         }
       597         rest {
       598             ambushChance = 19
       599             healthGain = 15
       600             foodCostPerMember = 4
       601             hoursAdvanced = 8
       602             hoursRestedReset = 14
       603             temperatureMax = 15
       604             tempLowLo = 6;       tempLowHi = 10
       605             tempVeryLowLo = 10
       606             tempLowDamage = 5;   tempVeryLowDamage = 5
       607         }
       608         hunt {
       609             successChance = 45
       610             timeCost = 5
       611             foodMin = 10; foodMax = 19
       612         }
       613         fatigue {
       614             level(threshold = 0,   textId = "subs.food_handler.tired")
       615             level(threshold = -4,  textId = "subs.food_handler.exhausted", drain = true)
       616             level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.food_handler.weak",      drain = true, pauseAfter = true)
       617             level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.faint",                  drain = true, lt = true)
       618         }
       619         combat {
       620             fleeChance = 95
       621             defendCap = 250
       622             hpDefenseDiv = 12
       623             encounterFoeCountMax = 8
       624             encounterPicCount = 5
       625             attack       { hitBonus = 1; damageSpreadMax = 4; confusionDiv = 3 }
       626             defend       { wsPenalty = 2; restThreshold = 5 }
       627             monsterAttack{ hitBonus = 1; damageDiv = 6; damageSpreadMax = 9; damageMin = 1 }
       628             run          { desperateChance = 31 }
       629             battleCry    { wsPenalty = 4 }
       630             dropTable("default") {
       631                 dropChance = 5; treasureChance = 59
       632                 treasureLo = 36; treasureHi = 46
       633                 magicLo = 100;   magicHi = 111
       634             }
       635         }
       636         driv {
       637             statRoll(min = 15, max = 70)
       638             start { x = 12; y = 9; gold = 1000; torches = 5; food = 100; timeLeft = 200; hoursRested = 14 }
       639             dailyTimeLeft = 175
       640         }
       641         map {
       642             rows = 40; rowsMax = 42; colsMax = 82
       643             locationBounds = (5..74) to (5..34)
       644             dungeonAvoid = "wm012"
       645         }
       646         wilderness {
       647             caveChance = 3
       648             quietChance = 91
       649             encounterSplit = 50
       650             encounterEasyTier = "weak"
       651             encounterHardTier = "wild"
       652             caveDungeonRange = 3..16
       653             caveEntryCost = 10
       654         }
       655         maxLevel = 28
       656         xpThresholds(
       657             0,       0,       2000,    4000,    8000,    12000,   20000,   28000,
       658             36000,   48000,   54000,   64000,   74000,   86000,   98000,   110000,
       659             125000,  150000,  180000,  240000,  300000,  400000,  550000,  700000,
       660             900000,  1100000, 1500000, 2000000, 2800000,
       661         )
       662         formulas {
       663             // donkey food cap = 150 + 150 * y  (where y is donkey count)
       664             formula("donkey_food_cap") { int(150) + (int(150) * v("y")) }
       665             // encounter_h1_scaled = h1_base + 2*party_avg + (first_level>2 ? first_level*2 : 0)
       666             formula("encounter_h1_scaled") {
       667                 v("h1_base") + (v("party_avg") * 2) + (v("first_level") * 2) // bonus folded; engine handles gate
       668             }
       669             formula("encounter_h2_scaled") { v("h2_base") + (v("first_level") * 3) }
       670             formula("reward_xp_per_survivor") {
       671                 (v("noc") * (v("h2") / 4) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)) + (v("sp") * 3)
       672             }
       673             formula("reward_gold_party") {
       674                 v("noc") * (v("h2") / 7) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)
       675             }
       676             formula("level_up_hp_floor") { (v("health") * 2) / 3 }
       677         }
       678     }
       679
       680     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       681     // State model. Every persistent flag/counter is declared here.
       682     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       683     stateModel {
       684         // Mission state machines (slug -> ordered states; "none" is implicit start).
       685         flag("garth.bandits",        "none", "accepted", "recovered", "closed")
       686         flag("ranger.letter",        "none", "accepted", "delivered")
       687         flag("fighter.priest_book",  "none", "priest_told", "priest_visited", "wizard_robbed", "fighter_grateful")
       688         flag("church.donation.once", "no",   "yes")
       689         flag("silver_key",           "none", "map_bought", "note_found", "thief2_squeezed",
       690                                      "smith_confessed", "cave_located", "key_taken")
       691         flag("erethor.lute",         "none", "rumour_told", "lute_taken", "note_received", "cloak_received")
       692         flag("bracelets.thun",       "none", "map_bought", "bracelets_taken")
       693         flag("nymph.seeker",         "none", "told", "wizard3t_active")
       694         flag("peasant_wife",         "none", "accepted", "rescued", "paid")
       695         flag("jazzy_ogre",           "none", "accepted", "ogres_cleared", "jazzy_defeated")
       696         flag("mastercrown",
       697              "none", "task1_assigned", "task1_done", "task2_assigned", "task2_done",
       698              "task3_assigned", "borin_met", "dagger_taken", "borin_paid",
       699              "crown_told", "crown_taken")
       700         flag("hermit.troll_tooth",   "none", "accepted", "extracted", "delivered", "fire_shield_acquired")

       872         // Magic items each carry a self-contained effect script. The bodies
       873         // here are lossy summaries -- the original DSL had 5..30 ops per item;
       874         // I record the *shape* of what each does.
       875         magic {
       876             magic("frost_wand", "Frost Wand", 1000) {
       877                 // wand shoots a cold beam at one foe, computing damage like
       878                 // mage.frost; consumed after use.
       879                 say("The wand crackles with frost.")
       880                 cast("mage.frost")
       881                 take("frost_wand")
       882             }
       883             magic("fire_wand", "Fire Wand", 1500) {
       884                 say("Flames erupt from the wand.")
       885                 cast("mage.fire")
       886                 take("fire_wand")
       887             }
       888             magic("gem_of_confusion", "Gem of Confusion", 800) {
       889                 say("The gem flares. Foes look bewildered.")
       890                 cast("mage.confusion")
       891                 take("gem_of_confusion")
       892             }
       893             magic("gem_of_blindness", "Gem of Blindness", 800) {
       894                 say("Light explodes from the gem.")
       895                 cast("mage.confusion")  // blindness routes through confusion path
       896                 take("gem_of_blindness")
       897             }
       898             magic("drums_of_death", "Drums of Death", 9000) {
       899                 say("A funereal drumbeat pounds. The earth trembles.")
       900                 cast("priest.earthquake")
       901                 take("drums_of_death")
       902             }
       903             magic("staff_of_healing", "Staff of Healing", 670) {
       904                 menu("Heal whom?") {
       905                     digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
       906                         on(state.member(who).isAlive()) {
       907                             state.member(who).setField("hit_points",
       908                                 state.member(who)["health"])
       909                             say("The staff bathes ${state.member(who).name()} in gold light.")
       910                             pause(800)
       911                         } els {
       912                             say("They are beyond a healing.")
       913                             pause(800)
       914                         }
       915                     }
       916                 }
       917             }
       918             magic("blessing_scroll", "Blessing Scroll", 250) {
       919                 say("You read the blessing aloud. Hearts strengthen.")
       920                 forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
       921                 take("blessing_scroll")
       922             }
       923             magic("staff_of_curing", "Staff of Curing", 480) {
       924                 forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
       925                 say("A wave of warmth fills the party.")
       926             }
       927             magic("gem_of_resurrection", "Gem of Resurrection", 12000) {
       928                 menu("Whom to revive?") {
       929                     digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
       930                         on(state.member(who).isDead()) {
       931                             state.member(who).setField("dead", 0)
       932                             state.member(who).setField("hit_points", 1)
       933                             state.pl += 1
       934                             say("Life flows back into ${state.member(who).name()}.")
       935                             pause(1200)
       936                         } els {
       937                             say("They live still.")
       938                         }
       939                     }
       940                 }
       941                 take("gem_of_resurrection")
       942             }
       943             magic("kaels_axe", "Kael's Axe", 6000) {
       944                 // Throw-and-return: hits all foes for moderate damage.
       945                 say("Kael's Axe whirls through the enemy ranks.")
       946                 // Effect handled via tagged combat hook.
       947                 engineCall("kaels_axe_strike")
       948             }
       949             magic("holy_handgrenade", "Holy Hand Grenade", 4500) {
       950                 say("Three. Four. ...")
       951                 pause(800)
       952                 say("FIVE.")
       953                 pause(400)
       954                 engineCall("holy_handgrenade_strike")
       955                 take("holy_handgrenade")
       956             }
       957             magic("flute_of_madness", "Flute of Madness", 9000) {
       958                 // Pure narration -- a curse item the player should not use.
       959                 say("You raise the flute and play.")
       960                 pause(1000)
       961                 say("Foes look puzzled. Your friends look terrified.")
       962                 pause(1500)
       963                 say("Then everything goes quiet.")
       964                 engineCall("flute_of_madness_strike")
       965                 take("flute_of_madness")
       966             }
       967         }

      1072     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1073     // Spells. Each effect is a self-contained Script body. The legacy DSL had
      1074     // 30..70 ops per spell; the bodies below capture the *shape* and key
      1075     // mechanics, with verbatim mana / target / damage rules where possible.
      1076     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1077     spells {
      1078         mage("frost", slot = 1, baseCost = 8, name = "Frost Finger") {
      1079             // Single-target cold beam. Damage = caster.level * (random 1..wis/3).
      1080             engineCall("ask_target")  // -> binds `target`
      1081             val dmg = letInt("dmg", state.member(v("caster")).level *
      1082                                     random(int(1), state.member(v("caster")).wis / 3))
      1083             text("spell.frost.beam")
      1084             pause(800)
      1085             mutate("monster.hp", "sub", v("dmg"))
      1086             on(engineCheck("monster_dead", v("target"))) {
      1087                 text("spell.kill")
      1088             }
      1089         }
      1090         mage("fire", slot = 2, baseCost = 25, name = "Fire Cloud") {
      1091             // AoE: rolls per-monster damage.
      1092             text("spell.fire.cloud")
      1093             pause(1000)
      1094             engineCall("for_each_monster",
      1095                 "body" to "spell.fire.tick")
      1096         }
      1097         mage("confusion", slot = 3, baseCost = 17, name = "Confusion") {
      1098             text("spell.confusion.sweeps")
      1099             pause(800)
      1100             engineCall("set_battle_flag", "confusion")
      1101         }
      1102         mage("death", slot = 4, baseCost = 78, name = "Death") {
      1103             engineCall("ask_target")
      1104             text("spell.death.invoke")
      1105             pause(1500)

      1107                 engineCall("monster_kill", v("target"))

      1109             } els {
      1110                 text("spell.death.resisted")
      1111             }

      1480     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1481     // Reusable scenes. Town services first, then dungeon encounters, then
      1482     // dialog dispatchers. Bindings the C wrappers used (open_lo, who, ...)
      1483     // come in via runScene().
      1484     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1485     scenes {
      1486         // -------- Town: hut greeter (T)alk / (L)eave -------------------------
      1487         scene("hut", expects = arrayOf("who", "npc_job_sym")) {
      1488             loop {
      1489                 clw()
      1490                 letBound("job",  "res_enum_name_by_sym", "job", v("npc_job_sym"))
      1491                 letBound("name", "res_enum",            "name", v("who"))
      1492                 screen("towne.hut.greeter")
      1493                 menu("menu") {
      1494                     option("T") { runScene("speak.dispatch", "building" to "none", "town" to 0) }
      1495                     option("L") { clw(); clearMap(); redrawMap(); breakOut() }
      1496                 }
      1497             }
      1498         }
      1499
      1500         // -------- Town: rumour roll. 33 rumours with four NPC-tagged cases. --
      1501         scene("rumour") {
      1502             val pick = letInt("pick", engineInt("rumour_roll"))
      1503             on(pick eq 12) {
      1504                 letBound("name1", "npc_name_at_role", "bandits_quest_giver"); text("towne.rumour.r12")
      1505             } els {
      1506                 on(pick eq 13) {
      1507                     letBound("name2", "npc_name_at_role", "rangers_quest_giver"); text("towne.rumour.r13")
      1508                 } els {
      1509                     on(pick eq 25) {
      1510                         letBound("name15", "npc_name_at_role", "crown_seer")
      1511                         letBound("loc15",  "npc_loc_at_role",  "crown_seer")
      1512                         text("towne.rumour.r25")
      1513                     } els {
      1514                         on(pick eq 27) {
      1515                             letBound("name13", "npc_name_at_role", "temple_of_thun_seer")
      1516                             letBound("loc13",  "npc_loc_at_role",  "temple_of_thun_seer")
      1517                             text("towne.rumour.r27")
      1518                         } els {
      1519                             emitIndexed("towne.rumour.r{}", v("pick"))
      1520                         }
      1521                     }
      1522                 }
      1523             }
      1524         }
      1525
      1526         // -------- Town: church (Heal/Raise/Energize/Leave) -------------------
      1527         scene("church") {
      1528             clearMap()
      1529             setBackdrop("church")
      1530             loop {
      1531                 clw(); statusLine()
      1532                 screen("towne.church.intro")

      1560                                     } els {

      1562                                         state.member(who).setField("magic", state.member(who).wis)
      1563                                         clw(); screen("towne.church.restored"); pause(1000)

      2079                             } els {
