        // Magic items each carry a self-contained effect script. The bodies
        // here are lossy summaries -- the original DSL had 5..30 ops per item;
        // I record the *shape* of what each does.
        magic {
            magic("frost_wand", "Frost Wand", 1000) {
                // wand shoots a cold beam at one foe, computing damage like
                // mage.frost; consumed after use.
                say("The wand crackles with frost.")
                cast("mage.frost")
                take("frost_wand")
            }
            magic("fire_wand", "Fire Wand", 1500) {
                say("Flames erupt from the wand.")
                cast("mage.fire")
                take("fire_wand")
            }
            magic("gem_of_confusion", "Gem of Confusion", 800) {
                say("The gem flares. Foes look bewildered.")
                cast("mage.confusion")
                take("gem_of_confusion")
            }
            magic("gem_of_blindness", "Gem of Blindness", 800) {
                say("Light explodes from the gem.")
                cast("mage.confusion")  // blindness routes through confusion path
                take("gem_of_blindness")
            }
            magic("drums_of_death", "Drums of Death", 9000) {
                say("A funereal drumbeat pounds. The earth trembles.")
                cast("priest.earthquake")
                take("drums_of_death")
            }
            magic("staff_of_healing", "Staff of Healing", 670) {
                menu("Heal whom?") {
                    digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
                        on(state.member(who).isAlive()) {
                            state.member(who).setField("hit_points",
                                state.member(who)["health"])
                            say("The staff bathes ${state.member(who).name()} in gold light.")
                            pause(800)
                        } els {
                            say("They are beyond a healing.")
                            pause(800)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            magic("blessing_scroll", "Blessing Scroll", 250) {
                say("You read the blessing aloud. Hearts strengthen.")
                forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
                take("blessing_scroll")
            }
            magic("staff_of_curing", "Staff of Curing", 480) {
                forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
                say("A wave of warmth fills the party.")
            }
            magic("gem_of_resurrection", "Gem of Resurrection", 12000) {
                menu("Whom to revive?") {
                    digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
                        on(state.member(who).isDead()) {
                            state.member(who).setField("dead", 0)
                            state.member(who).setField("hit_points", 1)
                            state.pl += 1
                            say("Life flows back into ${state.member(who).name()}.")
                            pause(1200)
                        } els {
                            say("They live still.")
                        }
                    }
                }
                take("gem_of_resurrection")
            }
            magic("kaels_axe", "Kael's Axe", 6000) {
                // Throw-and-return: hits all foes for moderate damage.
                say("Kael's Axe whirls through the enemy ranks.")
                // Effect handled via tagged combat hook.
                engineCall("kaels_axe_strike")
            }
            magic("holy_handgrenade", "Holy Hand Grenade", 4500) {
                say("Three. Four. ...")
                pause(800)
                say("FIVE.")
                pause(400)
                engineCall("holy_handgrenade_strike")
                take("holy_handgrenade")
            }
            magic("flute_of_madness", "Flute of Madness", 9000) {
                // Pure narration -- a curse item the player should not use.
                say("You raise the flute and play.")
                pause(1000)
                say("Foes look puzzled. Your friends look terrified.")
                pause(1500)
                say("Then everything goes quiet.")
                engineCall("flute_of_madness_strike")
                take("flute_of_madness")
            }
        }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Spells. Each effect is a self-contained Script body. The legacy DSL had
    // 30..70 ops per spell; the bodies below capture the *shape* and key
    // mechanics, with verbatim mana / target / damage rules where possible.
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    spells {
        mage("frost", slot = 1, baseCost = 8, name = "Frost Finger") {

// full.dsl.kts -- Rylween adventure, real-Kotlin DSL experiment.
//
// The file has two halves:
//
//   1. DSL framework  -- @DslMarker-tagged builder types + opcode shells.
//      Every body is `Unit` or `TODO()`; nothing here actually executes.
//      The point is that this file *compiles* against itself, and any
//      future engine could interpret the recorded structure.
//
//   2. The adventure  -- one big `adventure("rylween") { ... }` block at
//      the bottom assembling the full game from the world + scripts +
//      texts JSON5 currently in data/.
//
// The DSL choices are deliberate:
//
//   * Slug-keyed everything. Every cross-reference (item, monster, spell,
//     NPC, town, mission, scene, flag) is a string slug. No int slot tables,
//     no enum-by-position. State is a slug -> value map at runtime.
//
//   * Inline narration (`say "..."`) is allowed at any call site for
//     mission flavour. Shared / long text uses `text("speak.merchant.foo")`
//     and the engine resolves the id. Scenes that the legacy game used
//     `screen:` for stay as `screen("speak.merchant.offer")` -- those carry
//     their own clw + waitInput so the call site stays one line.
//
//   * Logic ops (`on`, `loop`, `forEachMember`, `menu`, `els`) are real
//     Kotlin builders, not strings. Conditions are typed `Cond`, integer
//     expressions are typed `IntExpr`. Mutations are operator-overload
//     property writes (`state.gold -= cost`).
//
//   * Random/procedural content uses generators declared once and reused.
//     Dungeons declare a `randomFill { ... }` table; quest dungeons spell
//     out specific floors with `floor(N) { run("scene") }` and let the
//     fill cover the rest.
//
//   * Items, monsters and spells live in tables at the top. Special
//     encounters can inline a unique monster (`monster("baron_ydarg") { ... }`
//     inside the encounter scope) -- the engine treats it as an anonymous
//     monster slug local to that scene.
//
// This file is an experiment; it is not wired into the engine. Treat it as
// a target shape to grow toward.
//
// =============================================================================

@file:Suppress(
    "unused", "FunctionName", "PropertyName",
    "MemberVisibilityCanBePrivate", "UnusedReceiverParameter",
    "RedundantSuspendModifier", "UNUSED_PARAMETER",
)

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTION 1 -- DSL framework (real Kotlin; bodies stubbed).
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

@DslMarker
annotation class RylDsl

// ---- expressions / conditions ---------------------------------------------

sealed interface IntExpr {
    operator fun plus(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "+", other)
    operator fun plus(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "+", Lit(c))
    operator fun minus(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "-", other)
    operator fun minus(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "-", Lit(c))
    operator fun times(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "*", other)
    operator fun times(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "*", Lit(c))
    operator fun div(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "/", other)
    operator fun div(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "/", Lit(c))
}

data class Lit(val v: Int) : IntExpr
data class Bin(val l: IntExpr, val op: String, val r: IntExpr) : IntExpr
data class VarI(val name: String) : IntExpr
data class FieldI(val target: String, val field: String) : IntExpr
data class IdxFieldI(val target: String, val idx: IntExpr, val field: String) : IntExpr
data class RandRange(val lo: IntExpr, val hi: IntExpr) : IntExpr
data class CallI(val fn: String, val args: List<Any>) : IntExpr

fun int(v: Int): IntExpr = Lit(v)
fun v(name: String): IntExpr = VarI(name)
fun random(range: IntRange): IntExpr = RandRange(Lit(range.first), Lit(range.last))
fun random(lo: IntExpr, hi: IntExpr): IntExpr = RandRange(lo, hi)
fun engineInt(fn: String, vararg args: Any): IntExpr = CallI(fn, args.toList())

sealed interface Cond
data class CmpC(val l: IntExpr, val op: String, val r: IntExpr) : Cond
data class FlagC(val slug: String, val value: String) : Cond
data class ChanceC(val pct: IntExpr) : Cond
data class AndC(val l: Cond, val r: Cond) : Cond
data class OrC(val l: Cond, val r: Cond) : Cond
data class NotC(val c: Cond) : Cond
data class CallC(val fn: String, val args: List<Any>) : Cond

infix fun IntExpr.lt(r: IntExpr): Cond = CmpC(this, "<", r)
infix fun IntExpr.lt(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "<", Lit(r))
infix fun IntExpr.gt(r: IntExpr): Cond = CmpC(this, ">", r)
infix fun IntExpr.gt(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, ">", Lit(r))
infix fun IntExpr.eq(r: IntExpr): Cond = CmpC(this, "==", r)
infix fun IntExpr.eq(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "==", Lit(r))
infix fun IntExpr.ne(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "!=", Lit(r))
infix fun IntExpr.gte(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, ">=", Lit(r))
infix fun IntExpr.lte(r: Int): Cond = CmpC(this, "<=", Lit(r))
infix fun Cond.and(r: Cond): Cond = AndC(this, r)
infix fun Cond.or(r: Cond): Cond = OrC(this, r)
operator fun Cond.not(): Cond = NotC(this)

fun chance(pct: Int): Cond = ChanceC(Lit(pct))
fun chance(pct: IntExpr): Cond = ChanceC(pct)
fun engineCheck(fn: String, vararg args: Any): Cond = CallC(fn, args.toList())

// ---- references -----------------------------------------------------------

class FlagRef(val slug: String) {
    infix fun eq(value: String): Cond = FlagC(slug, value)
    infix fun set(value: String) { /* recorded by enclosing Script */ }
}
fun flag(slug: String): FlagRef = FlagRef(slug)

class IntStateRef(val name: String) : IntExpr {
    operator fun minusAssign(amount: Int) = Unit
    operator fun minusAssign(amount: IntExpr) = Unit
    operator fun plusAssign(amount: Int) = Unit
    operator fun plusAssign(amount: IntExpr) = Unit
    fun set(value: IntExpr) = Unit
    fun set(value: Int) = Unit
}

class MemberRef(val idx: IntExpr) {
    val hp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "hit_points")
    val maxHp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "health")
    val mp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "magic")
    val wis = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "wisdom")
    val cha = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "charisma")
    val ws = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "weapon_skill")
    val level = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "level")
    val xp = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "experience")
    val dead = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "dead")
    val weapon = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "weapon")
    val armor = IdxFieldI("member", idx, "armor")
    fun isClass(slug: String): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_class", idx, slug)
    fun isAlive(): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_alive", idx)
    fun isDead(): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_dead", idx)
    fun isSpellcaster(): Cond = engineCheck("pa_is_spellcaster", idx)
    fun name(): String = "<bound:pa_name($idx)>"
    operator fun get(field: String): IntExpr = IdxFieldI("member", idx, field)
    fun setField(field: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
    fun setField(field: String, value: Int) = Unit
}

@RylDsl
class State {
    val gold = IntStateRef("gold")
    val food = IntStateRef("food")
    val torches = IntStateRef("torches")
    val timeLeft = IntStateRef("time_left")
    val hourOfDay = IntStateRef("hour_of_day")
    val hoursRested = IntStateRef("hours_rested")
    val pl = IntStateRef("pl")
    val cpl = IntStateRef("cpl")
    val cl = IntStateRef("cl")
    val partyMemberMax: IntExpr = engineInt("pa_party_member_max")
    val firstLevel: IntExpr = engineInt("pa_first_level")
    val aliveCount: IntExpr = engineInt("pa_alive_count")
    fun member(idx: IntExpr): MemberRef = MemberRef(idx)
    fun member(idx: Int): MemberRef = MemberRef(Lit(idx))
    fun inv(slot: Int): IntExpr = IdxFieldI("inventory", Lit(slot), "id")
    fun npcInTown(role: String): IntExpr = engineInt("npc_in_town", role)
    fun npcNameAtRole(role: String): String = "<bound:$role.name>"
    fun npcLocAtRole(role: String): String = "<bound:$role.loc>"
    fun pronoun(idx: IntExpr, kind: String): String = "<bound:pronoun($idx,$kind)>"
    fun objectName(itemIdExpr: IntExpr): String = "<bound:object($itemIdExpr)>"
    fun resEnum(table: String, key: IntExpr): String = "<bound:$table[$key]>"
    fun resEnumNameBySym(table: String, sym: String): String = "<bound:$table[$sym].name>"
}
val state = State()

// ---- script body ----------------------------------------------------------

@RylDsl
open class Script {
    // Output / I/O
    fun say(line: String) = Unit                           // inline narration; emits as text
    fun text(id: String) = Unit                            // emit by text id
    fun screen(id: String) = Unit                          // full screen: text + waitInput + clw
    fun pause(ms: Int) = Unit
    fun clw() = Unit
    fun clearMap() = Unit
    fun redrawMap() = Unit
    fun waitInput() = Unit
    fun statusLine() = Unit
    fun setBackdrop(picSlug: String) = Unit                // engine_call blitgfx
    fun journal(line: String) = Unit                       // appended to player journal
    fun narrate(actId: String) = Unit                      // emits a list of texts with pauses
    fun engineCall(name: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit
    fun emitIndexed(fmt: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
    fun letInt(name: String, value: IntExpr): IntExpr { return VarI(name) }
    fun letInt(name: String, value: Int): IntExpr = letInt(name, Lit(value))
    fun letBound(name: String, fn: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit

    // Control flow
    fun loop(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun breakOut() = Unit
    fun returnFromScript() = Unit

    // `on(cond) { ... } els { ... }`
    fun on(cond: Cond, then: Script.() -> Unit): ElseBranch = ElseBranch()
    class ElseBranch {
        infix fun els(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
    }

    // Member iteration
    fun forEachMember(block: Script.(MemberRef) -> Unit) = Unit
    fun forEachMember(includeDead: Boolean, block: Script.(MemberRef) -> Unit) = Unit

    // Mutation primitives that don't fit operator overloads
    fun mutate(target: String, op: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
    fun setFlag(slug: String, value: String) = Unit
    fun setFlag(ref: FlagRef, value: String) = Unit
    fun flagValue(slug: String): IntExpr = engineInt("flag_value", slug)

    // Menus
    fun menu(prompt: String? = null, block: MenuBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit

    // World / scene calls
    fun runScene(slug: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
    fun playMission(slug: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
    fun enterDungeon(slug: String) = Unit
    fun encounter(foe: String, mandatory: Boolean = false, tier: String? = null) = Unit
    fun reward(block: RewardBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit

    // Inventory
    fun give(item: String, count: Int = 1) = Unit
    fun take(item: String) = Unit
    fun invAdd(itemId: IntExpr, added: Script.() -> Unit, full: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun invList() = Unit
    fun setInventory(slot: IntExpr, item: String) = Unit
    fun setInventory(slot: Int, item: String) = Unit

    // Input
    fun inputString(maxLen: Int, accept: List<String>, match: Script.() -> Unit, miss: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun inputString(maxLen: Int, accept: String, match: Script.() -> Unit, miss: Script.() -> Unit) =
        inputString(maxLen, listOf(accept), match, miss)
    fun inputItem(slotVar: String, itemVar: String) = Unit
    fun inputNumber(varName: String, max: IntExpr) = Unit

    // Casting + spell support
    fun cast(spell: String) = Unit

    // Utility for inline expressions referring to a previously-bound `let`.
    operator fun String.unaryPlus(): IntExpr = VarI(this)
}

@RylDsl
class MenuBuilder {
    fun option(key: String, label: String? = null, then: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun digitRange(lo: Int, hi: IntExpr, indexVar: String = "who", then: Script.(IntExpr) -> Unit) = Unit
    fun keyRange(lo: String, hi: String, then: Script.(IntExpr) -> Unit) = Unit
    fun letterRange(lo: String, hi: String, then: Script.(IntExpr) -> Unit) = Unit
    fun default(then: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
}

@RylDsl
class RewardBuilder {
    var gold: Int = 0
    fun gold(amount: Int) { gold = amount }
    fun items(vararg slugs: String) = Unit
    fun cantCarryText(id: String) = Unit
    fun pickedUpText(id: String) = Unit
}

@RylDsl class NpcBuilder {
    var name: String = ""
    var job: String = ""
    var fixed: Boolean = false
    var towne: String? = null
    var building: String? = null
    var x: Int? = null
    var y: Int? = null
    var gender: String? = null
}

@RylDsl class WorldBuilder {
    fun towns(block: TownsBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun buildings(block: BuildingsBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun terrain(block: TerrainBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun dungeons(block: DungeonsBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun ydarg(block: YdargBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class TownsBuilder { fun town(slug: String, block: TownBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit }
@RylDsl class TownBuilder {
    var name: String = ""
    var x: Int = 0; var y: Int = 0
    var tax: Int = 0
    var hasChurch: Boolean = false
    var townClass: String = "village"
}

    fun building(slug: String, opensAt: Int, closesAt: Int) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class TerrainBuilder {
    fun tile(char: Char, glyph: String, color: String, klass: String? = null) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class DungeonsBuilder {
    fun dungeon(slug: String, block: DungeonBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun randomFill(name: String = "default", block: RandomFillBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class RandomFillBuilder {
    fun use(scene: String, weight: Int = 1) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class DungeonBuilder {
    var name: String = ""

    var fill: String = "default"
    fun floor(n: Int, block: FloorBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun floors(vararg ns: Int, block: FloorBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun floors(range: IntRange, block: FloorBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun bossFloor(scene: String) = Unit
    fun gating(flag: String, value: String) = Unit
}

    fun run(scene: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
    fun untilFlag(slug: String, value: String) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class YdargBuilder {
    var entry = 0 to 0
    var mapSize = 5
    fun confrontationSequence(vararg foes: String) = Unit
    fun roomDropTable(block: YdargDropBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
    fun pitfallTraps(vararg ids: String) = Unit
    fun stairItem(digit: Int, special: String, rejectMsg: String) = Unit
    fun narration(act: String, vararg textIds: String) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class YdargDropBuilder {
    var gateMax = 4
    var kindMax = 2
    var weaponsRange = 1..14
    var armorRange = 36..42
    var gearRange = 39..46
    var magicRange = 100..111
}

// Strings.
//
// The data uses raw `"""..."""` blocks. The framework normalizes them
// behind the scenes so the data file never has to mention `.trimIndent()`,
// `\n`, margin chars, or any other Kotlin-side string surgery:
//
//   * `str(id, body)` -- single text id. Body is normalized as if you had
//     called `body.trimIndent()`: the common leading whitespace is stripped,
//     and the leading / trailing blank lines that come from the `"""`
//     boundaries are removed. Each remaining line is one screen line.
//
//   * `screens(prefix, body)` -- declares a *chain* of related screens
//     under a shared prefix. Inside the body, lines that look like
//     `[tag]` start a new section; everything until the next `[tag]`
//     becomes one screen. The full id of each section is `prefix.tag`.
//     Same indent normalization as `str`.
//
//     This shape lets a related cluster of screens (a town greeter, a
//     mission's narration beats, a riddle's intro/riddle/pass/fail
//     variants) live next to each other without repeating the prefix
//     on every line.
//
// Both forms are pure data. The engine handles screen-width wrapping
// and \r\n at emit time; what you write here is what the player reads
// modulo line endings.
@RylDsl class StringsBuilder {
    fun str(id: String, body: String) = Unit
    fun screens(prefix: String, body: String) = Unit
}

@RylDsl class ScenesBuilder {
    fun scene(slug: String, vararg expects: String, body: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
}

@RylDsl class MissionsBuilder {
    fun mission(slug: String, block: MissionBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class MissionBuilder {
    var triggerKind: String = "position"     // position | random | terrain | dungeon_loc | enter_key
    var x: Int? = null
    var y: Int? = null
    var randomChance: Int? = null
    var terrainChar: Char? = null
    var dungeonSlot: Int? = null
    var returnsOnSkip: Boolean = false
    var requires: Cond? = null
    fun bindings(vararg pairs: Pair<String, String>) = Unit
    fun body(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
}

@RylDsl class SecretsBuilder {
    fun backdoor(slug: String, block: BackdoorBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
}
@RylDsl class BackdoorBuilder {
    var name: String = ""
    fun key(char: Char, action: String, vararg args: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
    fun stepTrigger(everyN: Int, action: String, vararg args: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
}

@RylDsl class KeymapBuilder {
    fun town(key: Char, action: String, requires: String? = null) = Unit
    fun combat(key: Char, action: String, requires: String? = null) = Unit
    fun wilderness(key: Char, action: String) = Unit
    fun pauseVerbs(vararg verbs: String) = Unit
}

fun adventure(slug: String, block: Adventure.() -> Unit): Adventure =
    Adventure(slug).apply(block)

val rylween = adventure("rylween") {

    meta {
        version = 1
        schema = "rylween-world-v0"
        textWindow = 26 to 15
    }

        }
        hunt {
            successChance = 45
            timeCost = 5
            foodMin = 10; foodMax = 19
        }
        fatigue {
            level(threshold = 0,   textId = "subs.food_handler.tired")
            level(threshold = -4,  textId = "subs.food_handler.exhausted", drain = true)
            level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.food_handler.weak",      drain = true, pauseAfter = true)
            level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.faint",                  drain = true, lt = true)
        }
        combat {

            defendCap = 250
            hpDefenseDiv = 12
            encounterFoeCountMax = 8

            attack       { hitBonus = 1; damageSpreadMax = 4; confusionDiv = 3 }
            defend       { wsPenalty = 2; restThreshold = 5 }

            run          { desperateChance = 31 }

            dropTable("default") {
                dropChance = 5; treasureChance = 59
                treasureLo = 36; treasureHi = 46
                magicLo = 100;   magicHi = 111
            }
        }
        driv {
            statRoll(min = 15, max = 70)
            start { x = 12; y = 9; gold = 1000; torches = 5; food = 100; timeLeft = 200; hoursRested = 14 }
            dailyTimeLeft = 175
        }
        map {
            rows = 40; rowsMax = 42; colsMax = 82
            locationBounds = (5..74) to (5..34)
            dungeonAvoid = "wm012"
        }
        wilderness {
            caveChance = 3
            quietChance = 91
            encounterSplit = 50
            encounterEasyTier = "weak"
            encounterHardTier = "wild"
            caveDungeonRange = 3..16
            caveEntryCost = 10
        }
        maxLevel = 28
        xpThresholds(
            0,       0,       2000,    4000,    8000,    12000,   20000,   28000,
            36000,   48000,   54000,   64000,   74000,   86000,   98000,   110000,
            125000,  150000,  180000,  240000,  300000,  400000,  550000,  700000,
            900000,  1100000, 1500000, 2000000, 2800000,
        )
        formulas {
            // donkey food cap = 150 + 150 * y  (where y is donkey count)
            formula("donkey_food_cap") { int(150) + (int(150) * v("y")) }
            // encounter_h1_scaled = h1_base + 2*party_avg + (first_level>2 ? first_level*2 : 0)
            formula("encounter_h1_scaled") {
                v("h1_base") + (v("party_avg") * 2) + (v("first_level") * 2) // bonus folded; engine handles gate
            }
            formula("encounter_h2_scaled") { v("h2_base") + (v("first_level") * 3) }
            formula("reward_xp_per_survivor") {
                (v("noc") * (v("h2") / 4) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)) + (v("sp") * 3)
            }
            formula("reward_gold_party") {
                v("noc") * (v("h2") / 7) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)
            }
            formula("level_up_hp_floor") { (v("health") * 2) / 3 }
        }
    }

                   SUMMARY OF LESS COMMANDS

      Commands marked with * may be preceded by a number, N.
      Notes in parentheses indicate the behavior if N is given.
      A key preceded by a caret indicates the Ctrl key; thus ^K is ctrl-K.

  h  H                 Display this help.
  q  :q  Q  :Q  ZZ     Exit.
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                           MOVING

  e  ^E  j  ^N  CR  *  Forward  one line   (or N lines).
  y  ^Y  k  ^K  ^P  *  Backward one line   (or N lines).
  f  ^F  ^V  SPACE  *  Forward  one window (or N lines).
  b  ^B  ESC-v      *  Backward one window (or N lines).
  z                 *  Forward  one window (and set window to N).
  w                 *  Backward one window (and set window to N).
  ESC-SPACE         *  Forward  one window, but don't stop at end-of-file.
  d  ^D             *  Forward  one half-window (and set half-window to N).
  u  ^U             *  Backward one half-window (and set half-window to N).
  ESC-)  RightArrow *  Right one half screen width (or N positions).
  ESC-(  LeftArrow  *  Left  one half screen width (or N positions).
  ESC-}  ^RightArrow   Right to last column displayed.
  ESC-{  ^LeftArrow    Left  to first column.
  F                    Forward forever; like "tail -f".
  ESC-F                Like F but stop when search pattern is found.
  r  ^R  ^L            Repaint screen.
  R                    Repaint screen, discarding buffered input.
        ---------------------------------------------------
        Default "window" is the screen height.
        Default "half-window" is half of the screen height.
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                          SEARCHING

  /pattern          *  Search forward for (N-th) matching line.
  ?pattern          *  Search backward for (N-th) matching line.
  n                 *  Repeat previous search (for N-th occurrence).
  N                 *  Repeat previous search in reverse direction.
  ESC-n             *  Repeat previous search, spanning files.
  ESC-N             *  Repeat previous search, reverse dir. & spanning files.
  ^O^N  ^On         *  Search forward for (N-th) OSC8 hyperlink.
  ^O^P  ^Op         *  Search backward for (N-th) OSC8 hyperlink.
  ^O^L  ^Ol            Jump to the currently selected OSC8 hyperlink.
  ESC-u                Undo (toggle) search highlighting.
  ESC-U                Clear search highlighting.
  &pattern          *  Display only matching lines.
        ---------------------------------------------------
        A search pattern may begin with one or more of:
        ^N or !  Search for NON-matching lines.
        ^E or *  Search multiple files (pass thru END OF FILE).
        ^F or @  Start search at FIRST file (for /) or last file (for ?).
        ^K       Highlight matches, but don't move (KEEP position).
        ^R       Don't use REGULAR EXPRESSIONS.
        ^S n     Search for match in n-th parenthesized subpattern.
        ^W       WRAP search if no match found.
        ^L       Enter next character literally into pattern.
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                           JUMPING

  g  <  ESC-<       *  Go to first line in file (or line N).
  G  >  ESC->       *  Go to last line in file (or line N).
  p  %              *  Go to beginning of file (or N percent into file).
  t                 *  Go to the (N-th) next tag.
  T                 *  Go to the (N-th) previous tag.
  {  (  [           *  Find close bracket } ) ].
  }  )  ]           *  Find open bracket { ( [.
  ESC-^F <c1> <c2>  *  Find close bracket <c2>.
  ESC-^B <c1> <c2>  *  Find open bracket <c1>.
        ---------------------------------------------------
        Each "find close bracket" command goes forward to the close bracket 
          matching the (N-th) open bracket in the top line.
        Each "find open bracket" command goes backward to the open bracket 
          matching the (N-th) close bracket in the bottom line.

  m<letter>            Mark the current top line with <letter>.
  M<letter>            Mark the current bottom line with <letter>.
  '<letter>            Go to a previously marked position.
  ''                   Go to the previous position.
  ^X^X                 Same as '.
  ESC-m<letter>        Clear a mark.
        ---------------------------------------------------
        A mark is any upper-case or lower-case letter.
        Certain marks are predefined:
             ^  means  beginning of the file
             $  means  end of the file
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                        CHANGING FILES

  :e [file]            Examine a new file.
  ^X^V                 Same as :e.
  :n                *  Examine the (N-th) next file from the command line.
  :p                *  Examine the (N-th) previous file from the command line.
  :x                *  Examine the first (or N-th) file from the command line.
  ^O^O                 Open the currently selected OSC8 hyperlink.
  :d                   Delete the current file from the command line list.
  =  ^G  :f            Print current file name.
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                    MISCELLANEOUS COMMANDS

  -<flag>              Toggle a command line option [see OPTIONS below].
  --<name>             Toggle a command line option, by name.
  _<flag>              Display the setting of a command line option.
  __<name>             Display the setting of an option, by name.
  +cmd                 Execute the less cmd each time a new file is examined.

  !command             Execute the shell command with $SHELL.
  #command             Execute the shell command, expanded like a prompt.
  |Xcommand            Pipe file between current pos & mark X to shell command.
  s file               Save input to a file.
  v                    Edit the current file with $VISUAL or $EDITOR.
  V                    Print version number of "less".
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                           OPTIONS

        Most options may be changed either on the command line,
        or from within less by using the - or -- command.
        Options may be given in one of two forms: either a single
        character preceded by a -, or a name preceded by --.

  -?  ........  --help
                  Display help (from command line).
  -a  ........  --search-skip-screen
                  Search skips current screen.
  -A  ........  --SEARCH-SKIP-SCREEN
                  Search starts just after target line.
  -b [N]  ....  --buffers=[N]
                  Number of buffers.
  -B  ........  --auto-buffers
                  Don't automatically allocate buffers for pipes.
  -c  ........  --clear-screen
                  Repaint by clearing rather than scrolling.
  -d  ........  --dumb
                  Dumb terminal.
  -D xcolor  .  --color=xcolor
                  Set screen colors.
  -e  -E  ....  --quit-at-eof  --QUIT-AT-EOF
                  Quit at end of file.
  -f  ........  --force
                  Force open non-regular files.
  -F  ........  --quit-if-one-screen
                  Quit if entire file fits on first screen.
  -g  ........  --hilite-search
                  Highlight only last match for searches.
  -G  ........  --HILITE-SEARCH
                  Don't highlight any matches for searches.
  -h [N]  ....  --max-back-scroll=[N]
                  Backward scroll limit.
  -i  ........  --ignore-case
                  Ignore case in searches that do not contain uppercase.
  -I  ........  --IGNORE-CASE
                  Ignore case in all searches.
  -j [N]  ....  --jump-target=[N]
                  Screen position of target lines.
  -J  ........  --status-column
                  Display a status column at left edge of screen.
  -k file  ...  --lesskey-file=file
                  Use a compiled lesskey file.
  -K  ........  --quit-on-intr
                  Exit less in response to ctrl-C.
  -L  ........  --no-lessopen
                  Ignore the LESSOPEN environment variable.
  -m  -M  ....  --long-prompt  --LONG-PROMPT
                  Set prompt style.
  -n .........  --line-numbers
                  Suppress line numbers in prompts and messages.
  -N .........  --LINE-NUMBERS
                  Display line number at start of each line.

                   SUMMARY OF LESS COMMANDS

      Commands marked with * may be preceded by a number, N.
      Notes in parentheses indicate the behavior if N is given.
      A key preceded by a caret indicates the Ctrl key; thus ^K is ctrl-K.

  h  H                 Display this help.
  q  :q  Q  :Q  ZZ     Exit.

                  Use an alternate tags file.
  -u  -U  ....  --underline-special  --UNDERLINE-SPECIAL
                  Change handling of backspaces, tabs and carriage returns.

                  Display the version number of "less".
  -w  ........  --hilite-unread
                  Highlight first new line after forward-screen.

                  Highlight first new line after any forward movement.

                  Set tab stops.
  -X  ........  --no-init
                  Don't use termcap init/deinit strings.
  -y [N]  ....  --max-forw-scroll=[N]
                  Forward scroll limit.
  -z [N]  ....  --window=[N]
                  Set size of window.
  -" [c[c]]  .  --quotes=[c[c]]
                  Set shell quote characters.
  -~  ........  --tilde
                  Don't display tildes after end of file.
  -# [N]  ....  --shift=[N]
                  Set horizontal scroll amount (0 = one half screen width).

                --exit-follow-on-close
                  Exit F command on a pipe when writer closes pipe.
                --file-size
                  Automatically determine the size of the input file.
                --follow-name
                  The F command changes files if the input file is renamed.
                --header=[L[,C[,N]]]
                  Use L lines (starting at line N) and C columns as headers.
                --incsearch
                  Search file as each pattern character is typed in.

  g  <  ESC-<       *  Go to first line in file (or line N).
  G  >  ESC->       *  Go to last line in file (or line N).
  p  %              *  Go to beginning of file (or N percent into file).
  t                 *  Go to the (N-th) next tag.
  T                 *  Go to the (N-th) previous tag.
  {  (  [           *  Find close bracket } ) ].
  }  )  ]           *  Find open bracket { ( [.
  ESC-^F <c1> <c2>  *  Find close bracket <c2>.
  ESC-^B <c1> <c2>  *  Find open bracket <c1>.
        ---------------------------------------------------
        Each "find close bracket" command goes forward to the close bracket 
          matching the (N-th) open bracket in the top line.
        Each "find open bracket" command goes backward to the open bracket 
          matching the (N-th) close bracket in the bottom line.

  m<letter>            Mark the current top line with <letter>.
  M<letter>            Mark the current bottom line with <letter>.
  '<letter>            Go to a previously marked position.
  ''                   Go to the previous position.
  ^X^X                 Same as '.
  ESC-m<letter>        Clear a mark.
        ---------------------------------------------------
        A mark is any upper-case or lower-case letter.
        Certain marks are predefined:
             ^  means  beginning of the file
             $  means  end of the file
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                        CHANGING FILES

  :e [file]            Examine a new file.
  ^X^V                 Same as :e.
  :n                *  Examine the (N-th) next file from the command line.
  :p                *  Examine the (N-th) previous file from the command line.
  :x                *  Examine the first (or N-th) file from the command line.
  ^O^O                 Open the currently selected OSC8 hyperlink.
  :d                   Delete the current file from the command line list.
  =  ^G  :f            Print current file name.
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                    MISCELLANEOUS COMMANDS

  -<flag>              Toggle a command line option [see OPTIONS below].
  --<name>             Toggle a command line option, by name.
  _<flag>              Display the setting of a command line option.
  __<name>             Display the setting of an option, by name.
  +cmd                 Execute the less cmd each time a new file is examined.

  !command             Execute the shell command with $SHELL.
  #command             Execute the shell command, expanded like a prompt.
  |Xcommand            Pipe file between current pos & mark X to shell command.
  s file               Save input to a file.
  v                    Edit the current file with $VISUAL or $EDITOR.
  V                    Print version number of "less".
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

        Most options may be changed either on the command line,

        Options may be given in one of two forms: either a single
        character preceded by a -, or a name preceded by --.

  -?  ........  --help

                  Dumb terminal.

// full.dsl.kts -- Rylween adventure, real-Kotlin DSL experiment.
//
// The file has two halves:
//
//   1. DSL framework  -- @DslMarker-tagged builder types + opcode shells.
//      Every body is `Unit` or `TODO()`; nothing here actually executes.
//      The point is that this file *compiles* against itself, and any
//      future engine could interpret the recorded structure.
//
//   2. The adventure  -- one big `adventure("rylween") { ... }` block at
//      the bottom assembling the full game from the world + scripts +
//      texts JSON5 currently in data/.
//
// The DSL choices are deliberate:
//
//   * Slug-keyed everything. Every cross-reference (item, monster, spell,
//     NPC, town, mission, scene, flag) is a string slug. No int slot tables,
//     no enum-by-position. State is a slug -> value map at runtime.
//
//   * Inline narration (`say "..."`) is allowed at any call site for
//     mission flavour. Shared / long text uses `text("speak.merchant.foo")`
//     and the engine resolves the id. Scenes that the legacy game used
//     `screen:` for stay as `screen("speak.merchant.offer")` -- those carry
//     their own clw + waitInput so the call site stays one line.
//
//   * Logic ops (`on`, `loop`, `forEachMember`, `menu`, `els`) are real
//     Kotlin builders, not strings. Conditions are typed `Cond`, integer
//     expressions are typed `IntExpr`. Mutations are operator-overload
//     property writes (`state.gold -= cost`).
//
//   * Random/procedural content uses generators declared once and reused.
//     Dungeons declare a `randomFill { ... }` table; quest dungeons spell
//     out specific floors with `floor(N) { run("scene") }` and let the
//     fill cover the rest.
//
//   * Items, monsters and spells live in tables at the top. Special
//     encounters can inline a unique monster (`monster("baron_ydarg") { ... }`
//     inside the encounter scope) -- the engine treats it as an anonymous
//     monster slug local to that scene.
//
// This file is an experiment; it is not wired into the engine. Treat it as
// a target shape to grow toward.
//
// =============================================================================

@file:Suppress(
    "unused", "FunctionName", "PropertyName",
    "MemberVisibilityCanBePrivate", "UnusedReceiverParameter",
    "RedundantSuspendModifier", "UNUSED_PARAMETER",
)

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTION 1 -- DSL framework (real Kotlin; bodies stubbed).
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

@DslMarker
annotation class RylDsl

// ---- expressions / conditions ---------------------------------------------

sealed interface IntExpr {
    operator fun plus(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "+", other)
    operator fun plus(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "+", Lit(c))
    operator fun minus(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "-", other)
    operator fun minus(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "-", Lit(c))
    operator fun times(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "*", other)
    operator fun times(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "*", Lit(c))
    operator fun div(other: IntExpr): IntExpr = Bin(this, "/", other)
    operator fun div(c: Int): IntExpr = Bin(this, "/", Lit(c))
}

data class Lit(val v: Int) : IntExpr
data class Bin(val l: IntExpr, val op: String, val r: IntExpr) : IntExpr
data class VarI(val name: String) : IntExpr
data class FieldI(val target: String, val field: String) : IntExpr
data class IdxFieldI(val target: String, val idx: IntExpr, val field: String) : IntExpr
data class RandRange(val lo: IntExpr, val hi: IntExpr) : IntExpr
data class CallI(val fn: String, val args: List<Any>) : IntExpr

fun int(v: Int): IntExpr = Lit(v)
fun v(name: String): IntExpr = VarI(name)
fun random(range: IntRange): IntExpr = RandRange(Lit(range.first), Lit(range.last))
fun random(lo: IntExpr, hi: IntExpr): IntExpr = RandRange(lo, hi)
fun engineInt(fn: String, vararg args: Any): IntExpr = CallI(fn, args.toList())

sealed interface Cond
data class CmpC(val l: IntExpr, val op: String, val r: IntExpr) : Cond

       180 @RylDsl
       181 open class Script {
       182     // Output / I/O
       183     fun say(line: String) = Unit                           // inline narration; emits as text
       184     fun text(id: String) = Unit                            // emit by text id
       185     fun screen(id: String) = Unit                          // full screen: text + waitInput + clw
       186     fun pause(ms: Int) = Unit
       187     fun clw() = Unit
       188     fun clearMap() = Unit
       189     fun redrawMap() = Unit
       190     fun waitInput() = Unit
       191     fun statusLine() = Unit
       192     fun setBackdrop(picSlug: String) = Unit                // engine_call blitgfx
       193     fun journal(line: String) = Unit                       // appended to player journal
       194     fun narrate(actId: String) = Unit                      // emits a list of texts with pauses
       195     fun engineCall(name: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit
       196     fun emitIndexed(fmt: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
       197     fun letInt(name: String, value: IntExpr): IntExpr { return VarI(name) }
       198     fun letInt(name: String, value: Int): IntExpr = letInt(name, Lit(value))
       199     fun letBound(name: String, fn: String, vararg args: Any) = Unit
       200
       201     // Control flow
       202     fun loop(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       203     fun breakOut() = Unit
       204     fun returnFromScript() = Unit
       205
       206     // `on(cond) { ... } els { ... }`
       207     fun on(cond: Cond, then: Script.() -> Unit): ElseBranch = ElseBranch()
       208     class ElseBranch {
       209         infix fun els(block: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       210     }
       211
       212     // Member iteration
       213     fun forEachMember(block: Script.(MemberRef) -> Unit) = Unit
       214     fun forEachMember(includeDead: Boolean, block: Script.(MemberRef) -> Unit) = Unit
       215
       216     // Mutation primitives that don't fit operator overloads
       217     fun mutate(target: String, op: String, value: IntExpr) = Unit
       218     fun setFlag(slug: String, value: String) = Unit
       219     fun setFlag(ref: FlagRef, value: String) = Unit
       220     fun flagValue(slug: String): IntExpr = engineInt("flag_value", slug)
       221
       222     // Menus
       223     fun menu(prompt: String? = null, block: MenuBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
       224
       225     // World / scene calls
       226     fun runScene(slug: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
       227     fun playMission(slug: String, vararg bindings: Pair<String, Any>) = Unit
       228     fun enterDungeon(slug: String) = Unit
       229     fun encounter(foe: String, mandatory: Boolean = false, tier: String? = null) = Unit
       230     fun reward(block: RewardBuilder.() -> Unit) = Unit
       231
       232     // Inventory
       233     fun give(item: String, count: Int = 1) = Unit
       234     fun take(item: String) = Unit
       235     fun invAdd(itemId: IntExpr, added: Script.() -> Unit, full: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       236     fun invList() = Unit
       237     fun setInventory(slot: IntExpr, item: String) = Unit
       238     fun setInventory(slot: Int, item: String) = Unit
       239
       240     // Input
       241     fun inputString(maxLen: Int, accept: List<String>, match: Script.() -> Unit, miss: Script.() -> Unit) = Unit
       242     fun inputString(maxLen: Int, accept: String, match: Script.() -> Unit, miss: Script.() -> Unit) =
       243         inputString(maxLen, listOf(accept), match, miss)
       244     fun inputItem(slotVar: String, itemVar: String) = Unit
       245     fun inputNumber(varName: String, max: IntExpr) = Unit
       246
       247     // Casting + spell support
       248     fun cast(spell: String) = Unit
       249
       250     // Utility for inline expressions referring to a previously-bound `let`.
       251     operator fun String.unaryPlus(): IntExpr = VarI(this)

       575 // =============================================================================
       576 // SECTION 2 -- The full Rylween adventure.
       577 // =============================================================================
       578
       579 val rylween = adventure("rylween") {
       580
       581     meta {
       582         version = 1
       583         schema = "rylween-world-v0"
       584         textWindow = 26 to 15
       585     }
       586
       587     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       588     // Balance: every numeric tuning constant lives here.
       589     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       590     balance {
       591         upkeep {
       592             foodCostLeaderDiv = 4
       593             foodTickEvery = 5
       594             starveDamage = 2
       595             manaRegenChance = 50
       596         }
       597         rest {
       598             ambushChance = 19
       599             healthGain = 15
       600             foodCostPerMember = 4
       601             hoursAdvanced = 8
       602             hoursRestedReset = 14
       603             temperatureMax = 15
       604             tempLowLo = 6;       tempLowHi = 10
       605             tempVeryLowLo = 10
       606             tempLowDamage = 5;   tempVeryLowDamage = 5
       607         }
       608         hunt {
       609             successChance = 45
       610             timeCost = 5
       611             foodMin = 10; foodMax = 19
       612         }
       613         fatigue {
       614             level(threshold = 0,   textId = "subs.food_handler.tired")
       615             level(threshold = -4,  textId = "subs.food_handler.exhausted", drain = true)
       616             level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.food_handler.weak",      drain = true, pauseAfter = true)
       617             level(threshold = -8,  textId = "subs.faint",                  drain = true, lt = true)
       618         }
       619         combat {
       620             fleeChance = 95
       621             defendCap = 250
       622             hpDefenseDiv = 12
       623             encounterFoeCountMax = 8
       624             encounterPicCount = 5
       625             attack       { hitBonus = 1; damageSpreadMax = 4; confusionDiv = 3 }
       626             defend       { wsPenalty = 2; restThreshold = 5 }
       627             monsterAttack{ hitBonus = 1; damageDiv = 6; damageSpreadMax = 9; damageMin = 1 }
       628             run          { desperateChance = 31 }
       629             battleCry    { wsPenalty = 4 }
       630             dropTable("default") {
       631                 dropChance = 5; treasureChance = 59
       632                 treasureLo = 36; treasureHi = 46
       633                 magicLo = 100;   magicHi = 111
       634             }
       635         }
       636         driv {
       637             statRoll(min = 15, max = 70)
       638             start { x = 12; y = 9; gold = 1000; torches = 5; food = 100; timeLeft = 200; hoursRested = 14 }
       639             dailyTimeLeft = 175
       640         }
       641         map {
       642             rows = 40; rowsMax = 42; colsMax = 82
       643             locationBounds = (5..74) to (5..34)
       644             dungeonAvoid = "wm012"
       645         }
       646         wilderness {
       647             caveChance = 3
       648             quietChance = 91
       649             encounterSplit = 50
       650             encounterEasyTier = "weak"
       651             encounterHardTier = "wild"
       652             caveDungeonRange = 3..16
       653             caveEntryCost = 10
       654         }
       655         maxLevel = 28
       656         xpThresholds(
       657             0,       0,       2000,    4000,    8000,    12000,   20000,   28000,
       658             36000,   48000,   54000,   64000,   74000,   86000,   98000,   110000,
       659             125000,  150000,  180000,  240000,  300000,  400000,  550000,  700000,
       660             900000,  1100000, 1500000, 2000000, 2800000,
       661         )
       662         formulas {
       663             // donkey food cap = 150 + 150 * y  (where y is donkey count)
       664             formula("donkey_food_cap") { int(150) + (int(150) * v("y")) }
       665             // encounter_h1_scaled = h1_base + 2*party_avg + (first_level>2 ? first_level*2 : 0)
       666             formula("encounter_h1_scaled") {
       667                 v("h1_base") + (v("party_avg") * 2) + (v("first_level") * 2) // bonus folded; engine handles gate
       668             }
       669             formula("encounter_h2_scaled") { v("h2_base") + (v("first_level") * 3) }
       670             formula("reward_xp_per_survivor") {
       671                 (v("noc") * (v("h2") / 4) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)) + (v("sp") * 3)
       672             }
       673             formula("reward_gold_party") {
       674                 v("noc") * (v("h2") / 7) * (v("weapon_skill") / 4)
       675             }
       676             formula("level_up_hp_floor") { (v("health") * 2) / 3 }
       677         }
       678     }
       679
       680     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       681     // State model. Every persistent flag/counter is declared here.
       682     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       683     stateModel {
       684         // Mission state machines (slug -> ordered states; "none" is implicit start).
       685         flag("garth.bandits",        "none", "accepted", "recovered", "closed")
       686         flag("ranger.letter",        "none", "accepted", "delivered")
       687         flag("fighter.priest_book",  "none", "priest_told", "priest_visited", "wizard_robbed", "fighter_grateful")
       688         flag("church.donation.once", "no",   "yes")
       689         flag("silver_key",           "none", "map_bought", "note_found", "thief2_squeezed",
       690                                      "smith_confessed", "cave_located", "key_taken")
       691         flag("erethor.lute",         "none", "rumour_told", "lute_taken", "note_received", "cloak_received")
       692         flag("bracelets.thun",       "none", "map_bought", "bracelets_taken")
       693         flag("nymph.seeker",         "none", "told", "wizard3t_active")
       694         flag("peasant_wife",         "none", "accepted", "rescued", "paid")
       695         flag("jazzy_ogre",           "none", "accepted", "ogres_cleared", "jazzy_defeated")
       696         flag("mastercrown",
       697              "none", "task1_assigned", "task1_done", "task2_assigned", "task2_done",
       698              "task3_assigned", "borin_met", "dagger_taken", "borin_paid",
       699              "crown_told", "crown_taken")
       700         flag("hermit.troll_tooth",   "none", "accepted", "extracted", "delivered", "fire_shield_acquired")
       701         flag("encounter.immune",     "no", "yes", scope = "encounter")
       702
       703         counter("gold",        initial = 1000)
       704         counter("food",        initial = 100)
       705         counter("torches",     initial = 5)
       706         counter("time_left",   initial = 200)
       707         counter("hour_of_day", initial = 5)
       708         counter("hours_rested",initial = 14)
       709         counter("pl",          initial = 4)
       710     }
       711
       712     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       713     // Enums. Slug-keyed; `id` from the legacy json5 is dropped -- callers refer
       714     // to entries by slug only.
       715     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       716     enums {
       717         enum("race") {
       718             entry("human")
       719             entry("dwarf")
       720             entry("elf")
       721             entry("halfling")
       722         }
       723         enum("pc_class") {
       724             entry("fighter") {
       725                 name = "Fighter"
       726                 minStat("weapon_skill", 50, "driv.create.weapon_skill_low")
       727                 levelup { weaponSkill = 3; health = 8; wisdom = 1; charisma = 1 }
       728             }
       729             entry("thief") {
       730                 name = "Thief"
       731                 levelup { weaponSkill = 1; health = 5; wisdom = 1; charisma = 2 }
       732             }
       733             entry("mage") {
       734                 name = "Mage"
       735                 minStat("wisdom", 50, "driv.create.wisdom_low")

       872         // Magic items each carry a self-contained effect script. The bodies
       873         // here are lossy summaries -- the original DSL had 5..30 ops per item;
       874         // I record the *shape* of what each does.
       875         magic {
       876             magic("frost_wand", "Frost Wand", 1000) {
       877                 // wand shoots a cold beam at one foe, computing damage like
       878                 // mage.frost; consumed after use.
       879                 say("The wand crackles with frost.")
       880                 cast("mage.frost")
       881                 take("frost_wand")
       882             }
       883             magic("fire_wand", "Fire Wand", 1500) {
       884                 say("Flames erupt from the wand.")
       885                 cast("mage.fire")
       886                 take("fire_wand")
       887             }
       888             magic("gem_of_confusion", "Gem of Confusion", 800) {
       889                 say("The gem flares. Foes look bewildered.")
       890                 cast("mage.confusion")
       891                 take("gem_of_confusion")
       892             }
       893             magic("gem_of_blindness", "Gem of Blindness", 800) {
       894                 say("Light explodes from the gem.")
       895                 cast("mage.confusion")  // blindness routes through confusion path
       896                 take("gem_of_blindness")
       897             }
       898             magic("drums_of_death", "Drums of Death", 9000) {
       899                 say("A funereal drumbeat pounds. The earth trembles.")
       900                 cast("priest.earthquake")
       901                 take("drums_of_death")
       902             }
       903             magic("staff_of_healing", "Staff of Healing", 670) {
       904                 menu("Heal whom?") {
       905                     digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
       906                         on(state.member(who).isAlive()) {
       907                             state.member(who).setField("hit_points",
       908                                 state.member(who)["health"])
       909                             say("The staff bathes ${state.member(who).name()} in gold light.")
       910                             pause(800)
       911                         } els {
       912                             say("They are beyond a healing.")
       913                             pause(800)
       914                         }
       915                     }
       916                 }
       917             }
       918             magic("blessing_scroll", "Blessing Scroll", 250) {
       919                 say("You read the blessing aloud. Hearts strengthen.")
       920                 forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
       921                 take("blessing_scroll")
       922             }
       923             magic("staff_of_curing", "Staff of Curing", 480) {
       924                 forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m["health"]) }
       925                 say("A wave of warmth fills the party.")
       926             }
       927             magic("gem_of_resurrection", "Gem of Resurrection", 12000) {
       928                 menu("Whom to revive?") {
       929                     digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
       930                         on(state.member(who).isDead()) {
       931                             state.member(who).setField("dead", 0)
       932                             state.member(who).setField("hit_points", 1)
       933                             state.pl += 1
       934                             say("Life flows back into ${state.member(who).name()}.")
       935                             pause(1200)
       936                         } els {
       937                             say("They live still.")
       938                         }
       939                     }
       940                 }
       941                 take("gem_of_resurrection")
       942             }
       943             magic("kaels_axe", "Kael's Axe", 6000) {
       944                 // Throw-and-return: hits all foes for moderate damage.
       945                 say("Kael's Axe whirls through the enemy ranks.")
       946                 // Effect handled via tagged combat hook.
       947                 engineCall("kaels_axe_strike")
       948             }
       949             magic("holy_handgrenade", "Holy Hand Grenade", 4500) {
       950                 say("Three. Four. ...")

       952                 say("FIVE.")

      1072     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1073     // Spells. Each effect is a self-contained Script body. The legacy DSL had
      1074     // 30..70 ops per spell; the bodies below capture the *shape* and key
      1075     // mechanics, with verbatim mana / target / damage rules where possible.
      1076     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1077     spells {
      1078         mage("frost", slot = 1, baseCost = 8, name = "Frost Finger") {
      1079             // Single-target cold beam. Damage = caster.level * (random 1..wis/3).
      1080             engineCall("ask_target")  // -> binds `target`
      1081             val dmg = letInt("dmg", state.member(v("caster")).level *
      1082                                     random(int(1), state.member(v("caster")).wis / 3))
      1083             text("spell.frost.beam")
      1084             pause(800)
      1085             mutate("monster.hp", "sub", v("dmg"))
      1086             on(engineCheck("monster_dead", v("target"))) {
      1087                 text("spell.kill")
      1088             }
      1089         }
      1090         mage("fire", slot = 2, baseCost = 25, name = "Fire Cloud") {
      1091             // AoE: rolls per-monster damage.
      1092             text("spell.fire.cloud")
      1093             pause(1000)
      1094             engineCall("for_each_monster",
      1095                 "body" to "spell.fire.tick")
      1096         }
      1097         mage("confusion", slot = 3, baseCost = 17, name = "Confusion") {
      1098             text("spell.confusion.sweeps")
      1099             pause(800)
      1100             engineCall("set_battle_flag", "confusion")
      1101         }
      1102         mage("death", slot = 4, baseCost = 78, name = "Death") {
      1103             engineCall("ask_target")
      1104             text("spell.death.invoke")

      1480     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1481     // Reusable scenes. Town services first, then dungeon encounters, then
      1482     // dialog dispatchers. Bindings the C wrappers used (open_lo, who, ...)
      1483     // come in via runScene().
      1484     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
      1485     scenes {
      1486         // -------- Town: hut greeter (T)alk / (L)eave -------------------------
      1487         scene("hut", expects = arrayOf("who", "npc_job_sym")) {
      1488             loop {
      1489                 clw()
      1490                 letBound("job",  "res_enum_name_by_sym", "job", v("npc_job_sym"))
      1491                 letBound("name", "res_enum",            "name", v("who"))
      1492                 screen("towne.hut.greeter")
      1493                 menu("menu") {
      1494                     option("T") { runScene("speak.dispatch", "building" to "none", "town" to 0) }
      1495                     option("L") { clw(); clearMap(); redrawMap(); breakOut() }
      1496                 }
      1497             }
      1498         }
      1499
      1500         // -------- Town: rumour roll. 33 rumours with four NPC-tagged cases. --
      1501         scene("rumour") {
      1502             val pick = letInt("pick", engineInt("rumour_roll"))
      1503             on(pick eq 12) {
      1504                 letBound("name1", "npc_name_at_role", "bandits_quest_giver"); text("towne.rumour.r12")
      1505             } els {
      1506                 on(pick eq 13) {
      1507                     letBound("name2", "npc_name_at_role", "rangers_quest_giver"); text("towne.rumour.r13")
      1508                 } els {
      1509                     on(pick eq 25) {
      1510                         letBound("name15", "npc_name_at_role", "crown_seer")
      1511                         letBound("loc15",  "npc_loc_at_role",  "crown_seer")
      1512                         text("towne.rumour.r25")
      1513                     } els {
      1514                         on(pick eq 27) {
      1515                             letBound("name13", "npc_name_at_role", "temple_of_thun_seer")
      1516                             letBound("loc13",  "npc_loc_at_role",  "temple_of_thun_seer")
      1517                             text("towne.rumour.r27")
      1518                         } els {
      1519                             emitIndexed("towne.rumour.r{}", v("pick"))
      1520                         }
      1521                     }
      1522                 }
      1523             }
      1524         }
      1525
      1526         // -------- Town: church (Heal/Raise/Energize/Leave) -------------------
      1527         scene("church") {
      1528             clearMap()
      1529             setBackdrop("church")
      1530             loop {
      1531                 clw(); statusLine()
      1532                 screen("towne.church.intro")
      1533                 menu("menu") {
      1534                     option("L") { clw(); clearMap(); breakOut() }
      1535                     option("E") { runScene("church.energize") }
      1536                     option("R") { runScene("church.raise") }
      1537                     option("H") { runScene("church.heal") }
      1538                 }
      1539             }
      1540         }
      1541         scene("church.energize") {
      1542             clw(); screen("towne.church.who")
      1543             menu {
      1544                 digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
      1545                     on(!state.member(who).isSpellcaster()) {
      1546                         clw(); screen("towne.church.not_spellcaster"); pause(1000)
      1547                     } els {
      1548                         on(state.member(who).mp eq state.member(who).wis) {
      1549                             clw(); screen("towne.church.no_need_sp"); pause(2000)
      1550                         } els {
      1551                             // cost = lv * (wi - ma) * 2
      1552                             val cost = letInt("cost",
      1553                                 state.member(who).level * (state.member(who).wis - state.member(who).mp) * 2)
      1554                             screen("towne.church.cost2")
      1555                             menu("pn_menu") {
      1556                                 option("P") {
      1557                                     clw()
      1558                                     on(state.gold lt v("cost")) {
      1559                                         screen("towne.church.no_gold"); pause(1000)
      1560                                     } els {
      1561                                         state.gold -= v("cost")
      1562                                         state.member(who).setField("magic", state.member(who).wis)

      2080                                 on(state.timeLeft lt 5) {
      2081                                     clw(); screen("hunt.too_few_moves"); pause(1000); breakOut()
      2082                                 } els {
      2083                                     state.timeLeft -= 5
      2084                                     letBound("who_name", "pa_name", who)
      2085                                     screen("hunt.tries"); pause(800)
      2086                                     on(chance(45)) {
      2087                                         val gain = letInt("fdplus",
      2088                                             random(int(10), int(19)) + state.member(who).level)
      2089                                         state.food += v("fdplus")
      2090                                         screen("hunt.succeeds")
      2091                                     } els {
      2092                                         screen("hunt.fails")
      2093                                     }
      2094                                     waitInput(); clw(); breakOut()
      2095                                 }
      2096                             }
      2097                         }
      2098                     }
      2099                 }
      2100             }
      2101         }

      2176         // -------- Rest --------------------------------------------------------
      2177         scene("rest") {
      2178             // Early gates.
      2179             on(state.hoursRested gt 0) {
      2180                 clw(); screen("rest.not_tired"); returnFromScript()
      2181             }
      2182             on(state.aliveCount eq 0) { returnFromScript() }
      2183             on(engineCheck("inv_has", "tent")) { setBackdrop("tent") } els { setBackdrop("notent") }
      2184
      2185             // Pick a guard (or no guard).
      2186             screen("rest.camp_intro")
      2187             val guard = letInt("guard", -1)
      2188             menu {
      2189                 option("Y") {
      2190                     loop {
      2191                         clw(); screen("rest.who")
      2192                         menu {
      2193                             digitRange(1, state.partyMemberMax) { who ->
      2194                                 on(state.member(who).isDead()) {
      2195                                     clw(); screen("rest.dead"); pause(1000)
      2196                                 } els {
      2197                                     mutate("guard", "set", who); breakOut()
      2198                                 }
      2199                             }
      2200                             default { clw(); screen("rest.not_valid"); pause(1000) }
      2201                         }
      2202                     }
      2203                 }
      2204                 option("N") { /* no guard */ }
      2205             }
      2206             on(v("guard") gte 1) { screen("rest.stands_guard") }
      2207             screen("rest.zzz"); pause(2000)
      2208
      2209             // Temperature roll.
      2210             val temp = letInt("temp", random(int(1), int(15)))
      2211             on((v("temp") gte 6) and (v("temp") lte 10)) {
      2212                 on(!engineCheck("inv_has", "blanket") and !engineCheck("inv_has", "tent")) {
      2213                     screen("rest.temp_low"); screen("rest.no_gear_5")
      2214                     forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m.hp - 5); engineCall("clamp_hp", m.idx) }
      2215                 }
      2216             }
      2217             on(v("temp") gt 10) {
      2218                 on(!engineCheck("inv_has", "tent")) {
      2219                     screen("rest.temp_very_low"); screen("rest.no_gear_10")
      2220                     forEachMember { m -> m.setField("hit_points", m.hp - 5); engineCall("clamp_hp", m.idx) }
      2221                 }
      2222             }
      2223
      2224             // Hours pass.
      2225             engineCall("advance_hour", "amount" to int(8))
      2226             state.hoursRested.set(14)
      2227             mutate("food", "sub", v("food_per_member") * state.pl)
      2228             engineCall("clamp_food_min", 0)
      2229
      2230             // Healing per non-guard non-dead member.
      2231             forEachMember { m ->
      2232                 on(m.idx ne v("guard") and !m.isDead()) {
      2233                     m.setField("hit_points", m.hp + 15); engineCall("clamp_hp", m.idx)
      2234                 }
      2235             }
      2236
      2237             // Ambush vs well-rested.
      2238             on(chance(19)) {
      2239                 screen("rest.ambush")
      2240                 on(v("guard") eq -1) {
      2241                     val victim = letInt("victim", random(int(1), state.partyMemberMax))
      2242                     letBound("victim_name", "pa_name", v("victim"))
      2243                     screen("rest.surprise_kill")
      2244                     state.member(v("victim")).setField("hit_points", 0)
      2245                     state.member(v("victim")).setField("dead", 1)
      2246                     state.pl -= 1
      2247                 }
      2248                 encounter("kobold", tier = "weak")
      2249             } els {
      2250                 screen("rest.well_rested"); clearMap()
      2251             }
      2252             redrawMap()
      2253         }

⏺ Good catch — those are unresolved.

  How they resolve today: The string in screen("missions.ogre_cave.no_trace") is a dotted text id that the opaque engine looks up via res_text(id). The lookup table is registered by the strings {
  import("texts/missions.json5") } block near the top of the DSL. That maps onto the existing data/world/texts/missions.json5 shard, which has a tree like ogre_cave: { no_trace: "You search the cave but
  find no trace...", kastagir_note: "...", leave_cave: "..." }. There's a two-step resolver (<script_id>.<name> then strip to <parent>.<name>) so the ids work whether the script is nested under
  missions.ogre_cave or shares the parent atom.

  But: that's exactly the shape you said you wanted to move away from for mission flavour. Your instruction earlier was:

  ▎ Inline narration at a call site is appropriate where it is small or where it is unique narration in a mission. Perhaps before/after a mission encounter — that may even contain logic make a choice or
  ▎ go to narration a or b or whatever.

  So screen("missions.ogre_cave.no_trace") is technically faithful to the current architecture but is a placeholder, not the target shape. The target shape would be:

  mission("ogre_cave") {
      body {
          // ...
          encounter("ogre_lord", mandatory = true)
          clw()
          say("You finish the lord and search the cave.")
          say("There's no trace of Tammy — only her torn cloak,")
          say("and a folded note in a hand you don't recognise.")
          waitInput(); clw()
          say("The note reads: '...'")
          // ...
      }
  }

  I left them as ids in this pass for two reasons:
  1. The full text corpus is ~15 shards; inlining everything verbatim would have added ~1500-2000 LOC and required reading every text file to copy strings I didn't have memorised.
  2. Some shards (common.*, speak.chit.*, terrain.*) genuinely should stay referenced — they're shared across many call sites or driven by emit_indexed dispatch.

  The mission-shaped ones (missions.bandits.*, missions.ogre_cave.*, etc.) and the unique mission-bound speak scenes (speak.husband.first_visit, speak.erethor.delivered_lute, etc.) are the strong
  candidates for actual inlining.

  Want me to do an inlining pass over the mission and unique-speak narration — read the relevant data/world/texts/missions.json5 and texts/speak.json5 shards and replace screen("missions.X.Y") with the
  actual say("...") lines? That would push the file to ~4500 LOC but make mission flow read like a screenplay, which is what you originally described.

⏺ The user is right — line arrays should be joined into single multi-line strings, not split into .0/.1 ids. Let me check the source format and fix it properly.

⏺ Read(/Users/marcus/src/rylween-raw/data/world/texts/common.json5)
  ⎿  Read 6 lines

⏺ Read(/Users/marcus/src/rylween-raw/data/world/texts/rest.json5)
  ⎿  Read 42 lines

⏺ You're right — those .0/.1/.2 ids are a translation artifact from the JSON5 line-arrays. Kotlin can do multi-line strings. Let me collapse them.

⏺ Bash(python3 <<'PYEOF'
      import re

      src_path = '/Users/marcus/src/rylween-raw/full.dsl.kts'
      src = open(src_path).read()

      # Locate strings block.
      start_marker = '    strings {\n'
      start = src.index(start_marker)
      remaining = src[start + len(start_marker):]
      end_idx = remaining.index('\n    }\n')
      old_body = remaining[:end_idx + 1]

      # Parse each line; group consecutive str("X.N", "...") with same X.
      str_re = re.compile(r'^(\s*)str\("([^"]*)", "((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"\)\s*$')
      indexed_re = re.compile(r'^(.*)\.(\d+)$')

      lines = old_body.split('\n')
      out_lines = []
      i = 0
      while i < len(lines):
          line = lines[i]
          m = str_re.match(line)
          if not m:
              out_lines.append(line); i += 1; continue
          indent, full_id, value = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
          im = indexed_re.match(full_id)
          if not im or int(im.group(2)) != 0:
              # Plain (non-indexed) or starts at non-zero -- emit unchanged.
              out_lines.append(line); i += 1; continue
          base_id = im.group(1)
          # Collect consecutive .0, .1, .2, ...
          parts = [value]
          j = i + 1
          n = 1
          while j < len(lines):
              m2 = str_re.match(lines[j])
              if not m2: break
              full_id2 = m2.group(2)
              im2 = indexed_re.match(full_id2)
              if not im2 or im2.group(1) != base_id: break
              if int(im2.group(2)) != n: break
              parts.append(m2.group(3))
              n += 1; j += 1
          if len(parts) == 1:
              # Single-element array -> drop the .0 suffix.
              out_lines.append(f'{indent}str("{base_id}", "{parts[0]}")')
          else:
              # Join with \n. Trailing empty parts become trailing \n.
              joined = '\\n'.join(parts)
              out_lines.append(f'{indent}str("{base_id}", "{joined}")')
          i = j

      new_body = '\n'.join(out_lines)
      new_src = src[:start + len(start_marker)] + new_body + src[start + len(start_marker) + end_idx + 1:]
      open(src_path, 'w').write(new_src)

      # Quick stats.
      old_str_count = sum(1 for l in lines if str_re.match(l))
      new_str_count = sum(1 for l in out_lines if str_re.match(l))
      print(f'str count: {old_str_count} -> {new_str_count}')
      print(f'block lines: {len(lines)} -> {len(out_lines)}')
      PYEOF
      wc -l /Users/marcus/src/rylween-raw/full.dsl.kts)
  ⎿  str count: 2506 -> 814
     block lines: 2533 -> 841
         4122 /Users/marcus/src/rylween-raw/full.dsl.kts
